commit.message:
[Fix] Keep TP ranks paired when a fanned-out request is aborted (#3233)

A stage whose scheduler takes replicated TP work, such as the Ming-Omni
image encoder with image_encoder.tp_size 2 or 4, lets every rank decide
on its own whether to skip an aborted request. The leader writes work
and aborts to separate follower queues, a follower drops work that
arrives after its abort, and each rank's scheduler skips a queued
request once its abort lands. When the ranks reach that point at
different times, one rank runs the aborted request while another moves
on, so two different requests meet in one collective and the next
request returns a wrong result or times out.

The leader still drops a request it sees aborted before fanout. After
fanout, every rank runs the request to completion and the leader stage
suppresses its output, so a follower runs all work it receives and TP
fanout ranks no longer forward the abort to their scheduler.

[Cascade] Keep markdown line markers, table pipes and bare URLs out of speech (B2) (#3218)

Qwen3-TTS read a list marker as "minus", garbled headings and table rows, read
a bare URL out symbol by symbol, and ran on to the 40 s cap on 29 of 300 real
reply spans, all of them table rows, list or quote lines, or headings.
openai_speech now drops heading, list and quote markers at the start of a
line, separates table cells with commas, and sends a bare URL as its host.
The reply text and reply.progress offsets are unchanged.

commit.message:
[Perf][PersonaPlex] Fuse Depformer pointwise ops with Triton (#2594)

* [Perf][PersonaPlex] Fuse Depformer pointwise ops with Triton

Fuse weighted RMSNorm and SiLU/gating with batched Triton kernels at the production dimensions. Preserve FP32 reduction order, low-precision activation rounding, and eager fallback for unsupported inputs and autograd.

Warm dtype and reduction variants before CUDA graph capture, retaining compatibility with the frame graph runner. Cover numerical parity, graph replay, cache reuse, and fallback behavior with focused regression tests.

Tests: 71 Depformer unit tests passed; affected-file pre-commit checks passed.

Refs #2458 (P1-3).

* [Cleanup][PersonaPlex] Remove pointwise kernel comments

* [Test][PersonaPlex] Simplify pointwise regression coverage

* Address PersonaPlex Triton fusion review feedback

---------

commit.message:
[Qwen3-Omni] Keep the thinker's prefill CUDA graph under EAGLE3 drafts (#3247)

* [Qwen3-Omni] Keep the thinker's prefill CUDA graph under EAGLE3 drafts

An EAGLE3 draft set cuda_graph_backend_prefill to DISABLED on the server
args the whole stage shares, so the target lost its prefill graph along
with the draft. SGLang 0.5.22 lets a breakable EAGLE3 draft prefill graph
read the composed multimodal embeddings, so drop the override and keep the
default breakable backend, as DFlash does.

* [Qwen3-Omni] Refresh the speculative decoding throughput table

Remeasure the baseline, DFlash and EAGLE3 columns on one H200 in the
same runs, now that EAGLE3 keeps the prefill CUDA graph.

commit.message:
[Fun-CosyVoice3] Speculative decoding with the SpeechSpec DSpark draft (#2938)

--tts_engine.engine.speculative_draft_model_path yuekai/cosyvoice3_llm_dspark
drafts 7 speech tokens per step with SpeechSpec's 3-layer DSpark head. The
published checkpoint is remapped to the stage vocabulary. Verification is exact
for CosyVoice3's sampler: temperature, top-k/top-p, the output repetition
penalty, the min-length stop mask and the repetition-aware redraw. Rejection
sampling runs against the draft's mirrored distribution, so accepted tokens
follow the non-speculative output distribution.

commit.message:
[Cascade] Keep the session when a client cancel lands during a component append (A7) (#3273)

* [Cascade] Keep the session when a client cancel lands during a component append

* [Cascade] Send component outputs on the session's read during appends

A preempt can land at any point while a component handles an appended chunk,
and the scheduler drops what a cancelled append streams back, so an output
sent on the append, such as the dialog's interrupt for speech.started, could
be lost. Every component output now goes out on the session's read.
---------

Co-authored-by: Yuhao Chen <yxckeis8@gmail.com>

commit.message:
[NPU] Enable PersonaPlex streaming decode graphs on Ascend (#3046)

* [NPU] Enable PersonaPlex streaming decode graphs on Ascend

The NPU platform now opts into the codec decode graphs. Capturing Mimi's decoder needs one more step: torch_npu rejects aclop operators during stream capture, and Mimi's Conv1d and ConvTranspose1d are lowered to aclop Conv2D and Conv2DTranspose. Disabling internal formats for the capture selects aclnn, and the documented default is restored afterwards.

The option is process-global, so a concurrent capture in another thread would see internal formats disabled. The LM backbone capture and the codec capture run sequentially today; keep that order, or serialize the captures if it changes.

Tests cover the capture-time toggle, its restoration on failure, and the platform policy. The NPU installation guide and the PersonaPlex cookbook document the backbone flag and the graph behavior.

* Improve comment clarity in device_graph.py

Refactor comment for clarity and formatting.

* delete

Removed the PersonaPlex section from the installation guide, including instructions and references.

* Apply suggestion from @ping1jing2

Co-authored-by: ronnie_zheng <zl19940307@163.com>

* Clarify aclnn

Updated the description of aclnn

* [NPU] Scope codec decode graphs to Mimi and restore internal-format state

- platforms: add enable_mimi_decode_graph() and leave the shared
  enable_codec_decode_graph() off on NPU, so Higgs TTS keeps the eager
  vocoder policy from #1721 while PersonaPlex still captures Mimi graphs.
- device_graph: read ALLOW_INTERNAL_FORMAT through torch_npu's option API
  and restore the caller's value after the capture, including on failure;
  Qwen3-TTS disables it around its whole warmup.
- tests: cover the Mimi-only platform policy and both initial option values
  on success and on a failed capture.
- docs: drop the duplicate NPU launch sentence from the PersonaPlex cookbook.

* [NPU] Use the platform device in PersonaPlex graph tests

The Mimi decode graph gate now admits NPU, so the two accelerator codec tests move the codec and codes to the current platform device instead of .cuda(). Annotate the NPU capture test parameters, and keep one signed line for the aclop capture constraint with the Mimi hook docstrings cut to the contract.

* [NPU] Split PersonaPlex known limitations by platform

Known limitations now has All platforms, CUDA and Ascend NPU subsections, so the two platforms are no longer interleaved and platform-neutral items are not mislabeled as CUDA-only.

---------

Co-authored-by: ronnie_zheng <zl19940307@163.com>

@@ -63,7 +63,7 @@ SGLang-Omni is a multi-stage serving runtime for omni, speech, and TTS models. I
 - **Music generation**: [MiniMax Music 3](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/minimax_music3.html) — lyrics + caption → 32 kHz stereo song.
 - **Speech generation**: [Higgs Audio v3](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/higgs_tts.html), [MOSS-TTS](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/moss_tts.html), [MOSS-TTS Local](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/moss_tts_local.html), [Fish Audio Drama 3](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/fishaudio_drama3.html), [Fish Speech S2-Pro](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/fishaudio_s2_pro.html), [Qwen3-TTS](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/qwen3_tts.html), [Fun-CosyVoice3](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/fun_cosyvoice3.html), [Voxtral TTS](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/voxtral_tts.html), [Ming-Omni-TTS](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/ming_tts.html), [Ming-3.0-TTS](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/ming3_tts.html), [dots.tts](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/dots_tts.html), [ZONOS2](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/zonos2.html) — `/v1/audio/speech`, with batch, streaming, and voice features varying by model.
 - **Instruction-driven speech generation and editing**: [AuK and AuK-Flash](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/auk.html) — text and voice instructions → speech; audio and editing instructions → edited speech.

+# Nemotron Transcribe
+
+[Nemotron Transcribe 30B-A4B](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B) serves whole-file transcription through `/v1/audio/transcriptions`. A native PyTorch frontend, speech transformer, and Sortformer speaker-fusion encoder produce audio embeddings for SGLang's NemotronH decoder. The serving path does not require NeMo.
+
+This integration accepts consolidated NeMo SpeechLM checkpoints with the `NeMoSpeechLMForConditionalGeneration` architecture, a NemotronH `llm_config`, and `perception` and `pe_encoder_config` sections. The checkpoint directory must contain its tokenizer files and model weights. The loader creates a small configuration shim and reads the original weights without copying them.
+
+## Serve a checkpoint
+
+Install SGLang-Omni following [Installation](../get_started/installation.md), then download the checkpoint:
+
+```bash
+hf download nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B
+```
+
+The BF16 30B-A4B checkpoint was validated on one H100 80 GB. Leave memory for audio encoding and graph workspaces in addition to the weights and KV cache:
+
+```bash
+sgl-omni serve \
+  --model-path nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B \
+  --model-name nemotron-transcribe \
+  --mem-fraction-static 0.85 \
+  --port 8000
+```
+
+On a fresh install, the first launch also builds FlashInfer kernels, which can take longer than the default 600 second startup timeout. Set `SGLANG_OMNI_STARTUP_TIMEOUT=1800` for that launch.
+
+The pipeline runs one ASR stage. It accepts uploads up to one hour, resamples to mono 16 kHz, and keeps each upload as one decoder request. Measured transcripts are the short clips in [Short-clip validation](#short-clip-validation): 4.352 s and 5.855 s. A one-hour recording can repeat sentences until the 16384-token response budget. The HTTP status stays 200. `json` and `verbose_json` then include `"finish_reason": "length"`. `text` sets `X-Finish-Reason: length`. A stream puts the same reason on `transcript.text.done`. The encoder processes the recording in checkpoint-defined windows with left and right context; the default checkpoint uses 40-second core windows.
+
+| Setting | Default | Purpose |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `--asr.engine.max_running_requests` | `64` | Maximum concurrent decoder requests |
+| `--asr.factory.encoder_max_batch_size` | `8` | Maximum waveforms per encoder invocation |
+| `--asr.factory.context_length` | `73728` | Decoder context budget in tokens |
+| `--asr.factory.max_new_tokens` | `16384` | Response token budget; `length` means the transcript stopped there |
+| `--asr.factory.chunked_prefill_size` | `4096` | Decoder prefill chunk in tokens |
+| `--asr.factory.mm_embedding_cache_size_bytes` | `0` | Audio embedding cache capacity |
+| `--asr.factory.compile_perception` | `false` | Compile encoder transformer layers |
+| `--asr.factory.perception_cuda_graphs` | `false` | Capture encoder graphs; requires compilation |
+
+Decoder CUDA graphs are enabled. Decoder compilation is unsupported in this integration; use encoder compilation to reduce launch overhead. Encoder batch size bounds activation memory separately from decoder concurrency. For longer audio or a smaller GPU, reduce the encoder batch size and choose a memory fraction that still fits the model weights.
+
+## Transcribe an upload
+
+```bash
+curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/v1/audio/transcriptions \
+  -F model=nemotron-transcribe \
+  -F file=@tests/data/query_to_cars.wav \
+  -F response_format=json
+```
+
+The default instruction asks for a verbatim transcript in the spoken language. Supply `prompt` to replace that instruction:
+
+```bash
+curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/v1/audio/transcriptions \
+  -F model=nemotron-transcribe \
+  -F file=@recording.wav \
+  -F 'prompt=Produce a verbatim transcript of the audio.' \
+  -F response_format=text
+```
+
+Set `stream=true` to receive text deltas as Server-Sent Events. The server encodes the uploaded audio before generating text; this is not live PCM streaming. Word timestamps, speaker-attributed output, translation, speculative decoding, and `/v1/realtime` are outside this integration.
+
+## Compile the encoder
+
+Enable compilation and encoder CUDA graphs independently of decoder graphs:
+
+```bash
+SGLANG_FLASHINFER_AUTOTUNE_EXTEND=1 \
+SGLANG_FLASHINFER_AUTOTUNE_CACHE=0 \
+sgl-omni serve \
+  --model-path nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B \
+  --model-name nemotron-transcribe \
+  --mem-fraction-static 0.85 \
+  --asr.engine.max_running_requests 16 \
+  --asr.engine.cuda_graph_max_bs 16 \
+  --asr.factory.encoder_max_batch_size 32 \
+  --asr.factory.request_build_max_workers 16 \
+  --asr.factory.request_build_max_pending 256 \
+  --asr.factory.compile_perception true \
+  --asr.factory.perception_compile_mode default \
+  --asr.factory.perception_cuda_graphs true
+```
+
+The first requests compile kernels and capture encoder shapes. Exclude this warmup from throughput measurements. Single-request serving uses static encoder compilation; concurrent serving uses dynamic batch shapes. Explicit encoder graphs use private pools and cache at most four shapes per encoder. Additional shapes run without capturing more graphs. `default` is the pipeline default and skips Inductor's kernel search. `max-autotune-no-cudagraphs` times candidates on the serving GPU and keeps graph ownership outside Inductor.
+
+For c=1, set both decoder limits to `1`. For long recordings, start with the default encoder batch cap rather than this profile's cap of `32`.
+
+## Validate the integration
+
+The unit suite covers pipeline registration, checkpoint conversion, tensor mapping, placeholder counts, request validation, text streaming, mel features, rotary positions, encoder padding, and graph replay across changed inputs.
+
+```bash
+pytest -q tests/unit_test/nemotron_transcribe
+```
+
+CPU tests run without checkpoint downloads. CUDA tests skip when CUDA is unavailable.
+
+RTFx is successful audio seconds divided by elapsed wall time, excluding warmup. Short-clip throughput and normalized transcript agreement do not establish WER on a representative evaluation corpus.
+
+## Benchmark on a corpus
+
+Use the shared ASR benchmark against the server name from the launch command:
+
+```bash
+python -m benchmarks.dataset.prepare --dataset seedtts
+python -m benchmarks.eval.benchmark_asr_seedtts \
+  --port 8000 --model-path nemotron-transcribe \
+  --concurrencies 1,16 --repeats 3 --warmup \
+  --disable-resource-monitor
+```
+
+This reports corpus WER, RTFx, and request latency. The resource monitor is disabled in this example to keep GPU sampling out of timed runs. Corpus WER results for this checkpoint are not included in the short-clip validation.
+
+## Short-clip validation
+
+On 2026-10-27, the default launch above ran on one H100 80 GB with BF16 and SGLang 0.5.22, keeping 64 decoder slots with encoder compilation and encoder graphs disabled.
+
+| Client concurrency | Median RTFx | RTFx range | Median p50 | Median p90 |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| 1 | 23.40 | 23.31 to 23.41 | 0.220 s | 0.229 s |
+| 16 | 102.17 | 100.22 to 104.91 | 0.716 s | 0.999 s |
+
+Each concurrency had three rounds of 256 measured requests on two English clips lasting 4.352 s and 5.855 s, with warmup requests excluded. All 1,536 measured requests succeeded with matching transcripts. These measurements cover short clips and do not establish long-audio throughput or corpus WER.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""DSpark draft for the Fun-CosyVoice3 LLM, served in the stage's speech vocabulary.
+
+The published draft (speculators format) indexes the unified text+speech vocabulary of
+an HF export of the CosyVoice3 LLM, where speech id k is unified id k + 151924. The
+stage samples only the 6761 speech and control ids, so the draft's embedding, head
+and Markov projections are remapped onto those ids at load time.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import tempfile
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+
+import torch
+from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.base_config import QuantizationConfig
+from sglang.srt.models.dspark import Qwen3DSparkModel, VanillaMarkov
+from torch import nn
+from transformers import Qwen3Config
+
+from sglang_omni.models.fun_cosyvoice3.dspark_sampling import (
+    DraftBlockSampler,
+    DraftSamplingState,
+    sample_draft_block,
+)
+from sglang_omni.models.fun_cosyvoice3.sglang_model import TOTAL_VOCAB_SIZE
+
+DRAFT_ARCHITECTURE = "FunCosyVoice3DSparkDraftModel"
+# Unified id of speech token 0 in the vocabulary the draft was trained on; the draft's
+# mask token follows the stage's speech and control ids there.
+UNIFIED_SPEECH_OFFSET = 151924
+UNIFIED_MASK_TOKEN_ID = UNIFIED_SPEECH_OFFSET + TOTAL_VOCAB_SIZE
+# note (wilsonzheng0327): the mask row needs an id inside the target vocabulary; the last
+# control id stops a request, so it is never an anchor or a proposal.
+MASK_TOKEN_ID = TOTAL_VOCAB_SIZE - 1
+DRAFT_TOKENS_PER_STEP = 7
+# The anchor and its drafts: one verify window, and the checkpoint's block size.
+VERIFY_TOKENS_PER_STEP = DRAFT_TOKENS_PER_STEP + 1
+
+DRAFT_CONFIG_FIELDS = (
+    "hidden_size",
+    "intermediate_size",
+    "num_hidden_layers",
+    "num_attention_heads",
+    "num_key_value_heads",
+    "head_dim",
+    "hidden_act",
+    "rms_norm_eps",
+    "attention_bias",
+    "attention_dropout",
+    "rope_theta",
+    "rope_parameters",
+    "rope_scaling",
+    "max_position_embeddings",
+    "layer_types",
+    "sliding_window",
+    "use_sliding_window",
+    "max_window_layers",
+    "torch_dtype",
+    "dtype",
+)
+
+
+def materialize_draft_checkpoint(draft_model_path: str, revision: str | None) -> str:
+    """Write a loadable copy of a speculators-format CosyVoice3 DSpark draft.
+
+    The copy has a flat qwen3 config that names the stage-vocabulary draft class
+    and links the original weights, which the draft class remaps when it loads.
+    """
+    source_dir = (
+        draft_model_path
+        if os.path.isdir(draft_model_path)
+        else snapshot_download(draft_model_path, revision=revision)
+    )
+    with open(os.path.join(source_dir, "config.json")) as config_file:
+        source_config = json.load(config_file)
+    if source_config.get("speculators_model_type") != "dspark":
+        raise ValueError(f"{draft_model_path} is not a speculators DSpark checkpoint")
+    elif source_config.get("markov_head_type") != "vanilla":
+        raise ValueError("Fun-CosyVoice3 DSpark supports the vanilla Markov head")
+    elif (
+        source_config.get("mask_token_id") != UNIFIED_MASK_TOKEN_ID
+        or source_config.get("block_size") != VERIFY_TOKENS_PER_STEP
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{draft_model_path} does not use the CosyVoice3 DSpark vocabulary "
+            f"and {VERIFY_TOKENS_PER_STEP}-token block"
+        )
+    else:
+        pass
+    layer_config = source_config["transformer_layer_config"]
+    draft_config = {
+        field_name: layer_config[field_name]
+        for field_name in DRAFT_CONFIG_FIELDS
+        if field_name in layer_config
+    }
+    # note (wilsonzheng0327): speculators aux id i reads the residual stream before
+    # decoder layer i, which SGLang captures for target layer id i - 1.
+    target_layer_ids = [
+        int(layer_id) - 1 for layer_id in source_config["aux_hidden_state_layer_ids"]
+    ]
+    if "sliding_attention" in draft_config.get("layer_types", []):
+        # A config without the flag would drop its window when loaded.
+        draft_config["use_sliding_window"] = True
+    else:
+        pass
+    draft_config.update(
+        model_type="qwen3",
+        architectures=[DRAFT_ARCHITECTURE],
+        vocab_size=TOTAL_VOCAB_SIZE,
+        tie_word_embeddings=False,
+        block_size=DRAFT_TOKENS_PER_STEP,
+        sample_from_anchor=False,
+        mask_token_id=MASK_TOKEN_ID,
+        markov_rank=int(source_config["markov_rank"]),
+        markov_head_type="vanilla",
+        enable_confidence_head=False,
+        dflash_config={
+            "target_layer_ids": target_layer_ids,
+            "mask_token_id": MASK_TOKEN_ID,
+            "block_size": DRAFT_TOKENS_PER_STEP,
+        },
+    )
+    draft_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="fun-cosyvoice3-dspark-")
+    with open(os.path.join(draft_dir, "config.json"), "w") as config_file:
+        json.dump(draft_config, config_file, indent=2)
+    for file_name in os.listdir(source_dir):
+        if file_name.startswith("model.safetensors"):
+            os.symlink(
+                os.path.realpath(os.path.join(source_dir, file_name)),
+                os.path.join(draft_dir, file_name),
+            )
+        else:
+            pass
+    return draft_dir
+
+
+class MirroredMarkovHead(VanillaMarkov):
+    """Markov head that draws each draft step from the target's shaping of it.
+
+    Rejection sampling divides by the proposal distribution, so the returned corrected
+    logits are exactly the shaped logits the draft drew from.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, *, vocab_size: int, markov_rank: int) -> None:
+        super().__init__(vocab_size=vocab_size, markov_rank=markov_rank)
+        self.sampling_state: DraftSamplingState | None = None
+        self.block_sampler: DraftBlockSampler = sample_draft_block
+
+    def draw_block(
+        self, base_logits: torch.Tensor, first_prev_tokens: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Draw the block from the stage-shaped logits and return those logits."""
+        state = self.sampling_state
+        assert state is not None, "a draft step needs its sampling state"
+        return self.block_sampler(
+            base_logits,
+            first_prev_tokens.long(),
+            torch.empty_like(base_logits).exponential_(),
+            self.markov_w1.weight,
+            self.markov_w2.weight,
+            state.presence_mask,
+            state.repetition_penalties,
+            state.output_lengths,
+            state.min_new_tokens,
+            state.temperatures,
+            state.greedy,
+        )
+
+
+class FunCosyVoice3DSparkDraftModel(Qwen3DSparkModel):
+    """DSpark draft whose embedding, head and Markov head use the stage vocabulary."""
+
+    uses_own_vocab_modules: bool = True
+    unreachable_logits: torch.Tensor
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: Qwen3Config,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(config=config, quant_config=quant_config, prefix=prefix)
+        hidden_size = int(config.hidden_size)
+        markov_rank = int(config.markov_rank)
+        self.embed_tokens = nn.Embedding(TOTAL_VOCAB_SIZE, hidden_size)
+        self.lm_head = nn.Linear(hidden_size, TOTAL_VOCAB_SIZE, bias=False)
+        self.markov_head = MirroredMarkovHead(
+            vocab_size=TOTAL_VOCAB_SIZE, markov_rank=markov_rank
+        )
+        # Stage ids outside the draft vocabulary are never proposed.
+        self.register_buffer(
+            "unreachable_logits",
+            torch.zeros(TOTAL_VOCAB_SIZE, dtype=torch.float32),
+            persistent=False,
+        )
+
+    def compute_base_logits(
+        self, hidden: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
+        logits = torch.mm(hidden, self.lm_head.weight.T, out_dtype=torch.float32)
+        return logits + self.unreachable_logits, None
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> None:
+        vocabulary_weights: dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
+        backbone_weights: list[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]] = []
+        for name, loaded_weight in weights:
+            normalized_name = name.removeprefix("model.")
+            if normalized_name in (
+                "embed_tokens.weight",
+                "lm_head.weight",
+                "d2t",
+                "markov_head.markov_w1.weight",
+                "markov_head.markov_w2.weight",
+            ):
+                vocabulary_weights[normalized_name] = loaded_weight
+            elif normalized_name == "t2d" or normalized_name.startswith(
+                "confidence_head."
+            ):
+                pass
+            else:
+                backbone_weights.append((name, loaded_weight))
+        super().load_weights(backbone_weights)
+
+        draft_to_unified = vocabulary_weights["d2t"].long() + torch.arange(
+            vocabulary_weights["d2t"].numel()
+        )
+        draft_to_stage = draft_to_unified - UNIFIED_SPEECH_OFFSET
+        # note (wilsonzheng0327): the mask slot is a control id, so a draft entry that
+        # maps there must not survive the remap either.
+        reachable = (draft_to_stage >= 0) & (draft_to_stage < MASK_TOKEN_ID)
+        device = self.lm_head.weight.device
+        dtype = self.lm_head.weight.dtype
+        stage_ids = draft_to_stage[reachable].to(device)
+        reachable = reachable.to(device)
+        stage_rows = slice(
+            UNIFIED_SPEECH_OFFSET, UNIFIED_SPEECH_OFFSET + TOTAL_VOCAB_SIZE
+        )
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            embedding = vocabulary_weights["embed_tokens.weight"].to(device, dtype)
+            self.embed_tokens.weight.copy_(embedding[stage_rows])
+            self.embed_tokens.weight[MASK_TOKEN_ID].copy_(
+                embedding[UNIFIED_MASK_TOKEN_ID]
+            )
+            self.lm_head.weight.zero_()
+            self.lm_head.weight[stage_ids] = vocabulary_weights["lm_head.weight"].to(
+                device, dtype
+            )[reachable]
+            markov_head = self.markov_head
+            markov_head.markov_w1.weight.copy_(
+                vocabulary_weights["markov_head.markov_w1.weight"][stage_rows]
+            )
+            markov_head.markov_w2.weight.zero_()
+            markov_head.markov_w2.weight[stage_ids] = vocabulary_weights[
+                "markov_head.markov_w2.weight"
+            ].to(device, dtype)[reachable]
+            unreachable = torch.ones(TOTAL_VOCAB_SIZE, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
+            unreachable[stage_ids] = False
+            self.unreachable_logits.copy_(torch.where(unreachable, float("-inf"), 0.0))

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Sampling math that keeps Fun-CosyVoice3 speculative decoding exact.
+
+The draft draws each proposal from logits shaped as the stage shapes them, and the
+verify rebuilds the stage's per-position distribution, including the repetition-aware
+redraw, before rejection sampling against the draft.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Protocol
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang_omni.models.fun_cosyvoice3.model_runner import COSYVOICE3_RAS_WINDOW_SIZE
+from sglang_omni.models.fun_cosyvoice3.sglang_model import TOTAL_VOCAB_SIZE, VOCAB_SIZE
+
+# Pads a request's repetition window before it has that many output tokens.
+EMPTY_HISTORY_TOKEN = -1
+
+
+@dataclass(kw_only=True)
+class DraftSamplingState:
+    """Per-request sampling inputs one speculative step mirrors on the draft.
+
+    Rows follow the running batch. presence_mask marks every committed output token
+    (the anchor included); output_lengths counts them. Greedy rows take the argmax.
+    """
+
+    presence_mask: torch.Tensor
+    repetition_penalties: torch.Tensor
+    output_lengths: torch.Tensor
+    min_new_tokens: torch.Tensor
+    temperatures: torch.Tensor
+    greedy: torch.Tensor
+
+
+class DraftBlockSampler(Protocol):
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        base_logits: torch.Tensor,
+        previous_tokens: torch.Tensor,
+        exponential_noise: torch.Tensor,
+        markov_embedding: torch.Tensor,
+        markov_projection: torch.Tensor,
+        presence_mask: torch.Tensor,
+        repetition_penalties: torch.Tensor,
+        output_lengths: torch.Tensor,
+        min_new_tokens: torch.Tensor,
+        temperatures: torch.Tensor,
+        greedy: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]: ...
+
+
+def shape_logits(
+    logits: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    presence_mask: torch.Tensor,
+    stop_suppressed: torch.Tensor,
+    repetition_penalties: torch.Tensor,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Mask stop ids on suppressed rows and penalize tokens already in the history."""
+    logits = torch.cat(
+        [
+            logits[:, :VOCAB_SIZE],
+            torch.where(
+                stop_suppressed.unsqueeze(1), float("-inf"), logits[:, VOCAB_SIZE:]
+            ),
+        ],
+        dim=1,
+    )
+    penalties = repetition_penalties.unsqueeze(1)
+    return torch.where(
+        presence_mask,
+        torch.where(logits < 0, logits * penalties, logits / penalties),
+        logits,
+    )
+
+
+def sample_draft_block(
+    base_logits: torch.Tensor,
+    previous_tokens: torch.Tensor,
+    exponential_noise: torch.Tensor,
+    markov_embedding: torch.Tensor,
+    markov_projection: torch.Tensor,
+    presence_mask: torch.Tensor,
+    repetition_penalties: torch.Tensor,
+    output_lengths: torch.Tensor,
+    min_new_tokens: torch.Tensor,
+    temperatures: torch.Tensor,
+    greedy: torch.Tensor,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Sample a draft block left to right, shaping each step as the stage would.
+
+    Each step's history includes the block's earlier drafts. Returns the tokens and the
+    shaped logits they were drawn from, which rejection sampling divides by.
+    """
+    draft_tokens: list[torch.Tensor] = []
+    shaped_logits: list[torch.Tensor] = []
+    for step_index in range(base_logits.shape[1]):
+        step_logits = shape_logits(
+            base_logits[:, step_index]
+            + (markov_embedding[previous_tokens] @ markov_projection.T).float(),
+            presence_mask=presence_mask,
+            stop_suppressed=(output_lengths + step_index) < min_new_tokens,
+            repetition_penalties=repetition_penalties,
+        )
+        sampled = torch.argmax(
+            step_logits / temperatures.unsqueeze(1)
+            - torch.log(exponential_noise[:, step_index]),
+            dim=1,
+        )
+        next_tokens = torch.where(greedy, torch.argmax(step_logits, dim=1), sampled)
+        draft_tokens.append(next_tokens)
+        shaped_logits.append(step_logits)
+        presence_mask = presence_mask.scatter(1, next_tokens.unsqueeze(1), True)
+        previous_tokens = next_tokens
+    return torch.stack(draft_tokens, dim=1), torch.stack(shaped_logits, dim=1)
+
+
+def target_probabilities(
+    logits: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    presence_mask: torch.Tensor,
+    stop_suppressed: torch.Tensor,
+    repetition_penalties: torch.Tensor,
+    temperatures: torch.Tensor,
+    top_ks: torch.Tensor,
+    top_ps: torch.Tensor,
+    recent_tokens: torch.Tensor,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The distribution the stage samples each row's next token from.
+
+    A row with top_k 1 is greedy; every other row redraws a sampled speech token found
+    in recent_tokens from the tempered distribution without it.
+    """
+    logits = shape_logits(
+        logits.float(),
+        presence_mask=presence_mask,
+        stop_suppressed=stop_suppressed,
+        repetition_penalties=repetition_penalties,
+    )
+    greedy = top_ks == 1
+    greedy_probabilities = torch.zeros_like(logits).scatter(
+        1, logits.argmax(dim=-1, keepdim=True), 1.0
+    )
+    tempered = torch.softmax(logits / temperatures.unsqueeze(1), dim=-1)
+    sorted_probabilities, sorted_ids = tempered.sort(dim=-1, descending=True)
+    cumulative = sorted_probabilities.cumsum(dim=-1)
+    ranks = torch.arange(logits.shape[1], device=logits.device).unsqueeze(0)
+    kept = (ranks < top_ks.unsqueeze(1)) & (
+        (cumulative - sorted_probabilities) <= top_ps.unsqueeze(1)
+    )
+    nucleus_sorted = torch.where(kept, sorted_probabilities, 0.0)
+    nucleus = torch.zeros_like(tempered).scatter(
+        1, sorted_ids, nucleus_sorted / nucleus_sorted.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
+    )
+
+    # Distinct speech ids of the window; repeats and padding contribute nothing.
+    sorted_recent, _ = recent_tokens.sort(dim=-1)
+    is_repeat = torch.cat(
+        [
+            torch.zeros_like(sorted_recent[:, :1], dtype=torch.bool),
+            sorted_recent[:, 1:] == sorted_recent[:, :-1],
+        ],
+        dim=1,
+    )
+    valid = (
+        (sorted_recent != EMPTY_HISTORY_TOKEN)
+        & (sorted_recent < VOCAB_SIZE)
+        & ~is_repeat
+    )
+    window_ids = sorted_recent.clamp_min(0)
+    tempered_double = tempered.double()
+    nucleus_double = nucleus.double()
+    window_tempered = torch.where(valid, tempered_double.gather(1, window_ids), 0.0)
+    window_nucleus = torch.where(valid, nucleus_double.gather(1, window_ids), 0.0)
+    in_window = (
+        torch.zeros_like(tempered_double).scatter_add(1, window_ids, valid.double()) > 0
+    )
+    # note (wilsonzheng0327): the redraw normalizes by the mass left after zeroing the
+    # candidate, and keeps the candidate only when nothing is left. Summing the mass
+    # outside the window directly avoids cancelling it against a near-1 candidate.
+    outside_window = torch.where(in_window, 0.0, tempered_double).sum(
+        dim=-1, keepdim=True
+    )
+    other_window_slots = ~torch.eye(
+        window_ids.shape[1], dtype=torch.bool, device=window_ids.device
+    )
+    remaining = outside_window + (
+        window_tempered.unsqueeze(1) * other_window_slots
+    ).sum(dim=-1)
+    redraw_weight = torch.where(remaining > 0, window_nucleus / remaining, 0.0)
+    kept_weight = torch.where(remaining > 0, 0.0, window_nucleus)
+    redrawn = torch.where(in_window, 0.0, nucleus_double) + tempered_double * (
+        redraw_weight.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
+    )
+    redrawn = redrawn.scatter_add(
+        1, window_ids, kept_weight - redraw_weight * window_tempered
+    )
+    return torch.where(greedy.unsqueeze(1), greedy_probabilities, redrawn.float())
+
+
+# note (wilsonzheng0327): inductor (torch 2.13) emits an invalid Triton kernel when it
+# fuses the residual draw with the gathers, so this part stays eager.
+@torch.compiler.disable
+def rejection_sample(
+    *,
+    target: torch.Tensor,
+    draft_logits: torch.Tensor,
+    draft_tokens: torch.Tensor,
+    temperatures: torch.Tensor,
+    greedy: torch.Tensor,
+    uniform_noise: torch.Tensor,
+    exponential_noise: torch.Tensor,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Accept a prefix of the drafts and sample the token that follows it.
+
+    target is [batch, drafts + 1, vocab]; the drafts were drawn from draft_logits at the
+    same temperatures. uniform_noise and exponential_noise are the Uniform and Exp(1) draws.
+    """
+    draft_count = draft_tokens.shape[1]
+    draft_probabilities = torch.softmax(
+        draft_logits.float() / temperatures.view(-1, 1, 1), dim=-1
+    )
+    draft_probabilities = torch.where(
+        greedy.view(-1, 1, 1),
+        torch.zeros_like(draft_probabilities).scatter(
+            2, draft_tokens.unsqueeze(2), 1.0
+        ),
+        draft_probabilities,
+    )
+    token_index = draft_tokens.long().unsqueeze(2)

+class StepSamplingState:
+    """Sampling inputs of the running requests for one speculative step."""

+    draft: DraftSamplingState
+    recent_tokens: torch.Tensor

+class RequestHistories:
+    """Which tokens each request slot has committed, kept on the device.
+
+    A step uploads only the tokens committed since that slot's last step; a slot is
+    cleared when a different request takes it over.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, *, slot_count: int, device: torch.device) -> None:
+        self.presence_by_slot: torch.Tensor = torch.zeros(
+            (slot_count, TOTAL_VOCAB_SIZE), dtype=torch.bool, device=device
+        )
+        self.slot_owners: list[str | None] = [None] * slot_count
+        self.slot_lengths: list[int] = [0] * slot_count
+
+    def presence_mask(self, batch: ScheduleBatch) -> torch.Tensor:
+        cleared_slots: list[int] = []
+        update_slots: list[int] = []
+        update_tokens: list[int] = []
+        for request in batch.reqs:
+            slot = request.kv.req_pool_idx
+            output_ids = request.output_ids
+            # Every step grows a request's outputs, so a length that did not grow
+            # means a new request reused the id.
+            if self.slot_owners[slot] != request.rid or self.slot_lengths[slot] >= len(
+                output_ids
+            ):
+                cleared_slots.append(slot)
+                self.slot_owners[slot] = request.rid
+                synced_length = 0
+            else:
+                synced_length = self.slot_lengths[slot]
+            update_tokens.extend(output_ids[synced_length:])
+            update_slots.extend([slot] * (len(output_ids) - synced_length))
+            self.slot_lengths[slot] = len(output_ids)
+        device = self.presence_by_slot.device
+        if cleared_slots:
+            self.presence_by_slot[torch.tensor(cleared_slots, device=device)] = False
+        else:
+            pass
+        if update_tokens:
+            self.presence_by_slot[
+                torch.tensor(update_slots, device=device),
+                torch.tensor(update_tokens, dtype=torch.long, device=device),
+            ] = True
+        else:
+            pass
+        return self.presence_by_slot[batch.req_pool_indices]

+def build_step_sampling_state(
+    batch: ScheduleBatch,

+            )
+            + list(request.output_ids[-COSYVOICE3_RAS_WINDOW_SIZE:])
+            for request in batch.reqs
+        ],
+        dtype=torch.long,
+    )
+    # One host-to-device copy carries the three per-request values.
+    request_values = torch.tensor(
+        [
+            [
+                request.sampling_params.repetition_penalty,
+                len(request.output_ids),
+                request.sampling_params.min_new_tokens,
+            ]
+            for request in batch.reqs
+        ],
+        dtype=torch.float64,
+    ).to(device)

+    top_ps = sampling_info.top_ps.view(-1).float()
+    if not (sampling_info.need_top_p_sampling or sampling_info.need_top_k_sampling):
+        # The stage samples the full softmax when no request filters tokens.
+        top_ps = torch.full_like(top_ps, float("inf"))
+    else:
+        pass
+    return StepSamplingState(
+        draft=DraftSamplingState(
+            presence_mask=histories.presence_mask(batch),
+            repetition_penalties=request_values[:, 0].float(),
+            output_lengths=request_values[:, 1].long(),
+            min_new_tokens=request_values[:, 2].long(),
+            temperatures=sampling_info.temperatures.view(-1).float(),
+            greedy=top_ks == 1,
+        ),
+        recent_tokens=recent_tokens.to(device),
+        top_ks=top_ks,
+        top_ps=top_ps,

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Classify consolidated perception and language-model checkpoint tensors."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Literal
+
+CheckpointTensorKind = Literal["skip", "perception", "rename", "split_down", "split_up"]
+
+FP32_PARAM_HOLDER_RENAMES = {
+    ".mixer._fp32_params.A_log": ".mixer.A_log",
+    ".mixer._fp32_params.dt_bias": ".mixer.dt_bias",
+    ".mixer._fp32_params.D": ".mixer.D",
+}
+SKIPPED_CHECKPOINT_PREFIXES = (
+    "llm.mtp.",
+    "ctc_timestamp.",
+    "perception.encoder.diarization_model.preprocessor.",
+)
+
+
+def classify_checkpoint_name(name: str) -> tuple[CheckpointTensorKind, str]:
+    """Return the tensor kind and its target name or fused expert module prefix."""
+    if "._extra_state" in name or name.startswith(SKIPPED_CHECKPOINT_PREFIXES):
+        return "skip", ""
+    else:
+        pass
+    if name.startswith("perception."):
+        return "perception", name[len("perception.") :]
+    else:
+        pass
+    hf_name = name.replace("llm.model.", "backbone.", 1)
+    hf_name = hf_name.replace("llm.lm_head", "lm_head", 1)
+    for holder, target in FP32_PARAM_HOLDER_RENAMES.items():
+        if hf_name.endswith(holder):
+            hf_name = hf_name[: -len(holder)] + target
+            break
+        else:
+            pass
+    if hf_name == "backbone.norm.weight":
+        hf_name = "backbone.norm_f.weight"
+    else:
+        pass
+    if hf_name.endswith(".experts.down_projs"):
+        return "split_down", hf_name[: -len(".experts.down_projs")]
+    elif hf_name.endswith(".experts.gate_and_up_projs"):
+        return "split_up", hf_name[: -len(".experts.gate_and_up_projs")]
+    else:
+        return "rename", hf_name

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Stream consolidated checkpoint tensors into the NemotronH decoder."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang_omni.models.nemotron_transcribe.checkpoint_contract import (

+
+def checkpoint_to_language_model_weights(
+    weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]],
+) -> Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]:
+    """Yield NemotronH parameter names and tensors for language_model.load_weights."""
+    for name, tensor in weights:
+        kind, payload = classify_checkpoint_name(name)
+        if kind == "split_down":
+            for index in range(tensor.shape[0]):
+                yield f"{payload}.experts.{index}.down_proj.weight", tensor[index].t()
+        elif kind == "split_up":
+            for index in range(tensor.shape[0]):
+                yield f"{payload}.experts.{index}.up_proj.weight", tensor[index].t()
+        elif kind == "rename":
+            yield payload, tensor
+        else:
+            continue

+"""Bounded encoder CUDA graphs, independent of the decoder's capture pool."""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Protocol
+
+import torch
+
+MAX_CACHED_ENCODER_SHAPES = 4
+ENCODER_GRAPH_WARMUP_STEPS = 2
+
+
+class EncoderLayersForward(Protocol):
+    def __call__(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, valid_key_mask: torch.Tensor | None, /
+    ) -> torch.Tensor: ...
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, kw_only=True)
+class EncoderGraphShape:
+    hidden_shape: tuple[int, ...]
+    hidden_strides: tuple[int, ...]
+    hidden_dtype: torch.dtype
+    device: torch.device
+    mask_shape: tuple[int, ...] | None
+    mask_strides: tuple[int, ...] | None
+
+
+@dataclass(kw_only=True)
+class EncoderGraph:
+    graph: torch.cuda.CUDAGraph
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor
+    valid_key_mask: torch.Tensor | None
+    output: torch.Tensor
+
+
+class EncoderCudaGraphs:
+    def __init__(self, forward: EncoderLayersForward) -> None:
+        self.forward = forward
+        self.captures: dict[EncoderGraphShape, EncoderGraph] = {}
+
+    def __call__(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, valid_key_mask: torch.Tensor | None
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        shape = EncoderGraphShape(
+            hidden_shape=tuple(hidden_states.shape),
+            hidden_strides=hidden_states.stride(),
+            hidden_dtype=hidden_states.dtype,
+            device=hidden_states.device,
+            mask_shape=None if valid_key_mask is None else tuple(valid_key_mask.shape),
+            mask_strides=None if valid_key_mask is None else valid_key_mask.stride(),
+        )
+        capture = self.captures.get(shape)
+        if capture is None:
+            if len(self.captures) >= MAX_CACHED_ENCODER_SHAPES:
+                return self.forward(hidden_states, valid_key_mask)
+            else:
+                pass
+            static_hidden_states = hidden_states.clone()
+            static_key_mask = None if valid_key_mask is None else valid_key_mask.clone()
+            current_stream = torch.cuda.current_stream(hidden_states.device)
+            capture_stream = torch.cuda.Stream(device=hidden_states.device)
+            capture_stream.wait_stream(current_stream)
+            with torch.cuda.stream(capture_stream):
+                for _ in range(ENCODER_GRAPH_WARMUP_STEPS):
+                    self.forward(static_hidden_states, static_key_mask)
+            current_stream.wait_stream(capture_stream)
+            graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+            # note (yhayaran): Separate pools allow shapes to replay in any order.
+            with torch.cuda.graph(graph, stream=capture_stream):
+                static_output = self.forward(static_hidden_states, static_key_mask)
+            current_stream.wait_stream(capture_stream)
+            capture = EncoderGraph(
+                graph=graph,
+                hidden_states=static_hidden_states,
+                valid_key_mask=static_key_mask,
+                output=static_output,
+            )
+            self.captures[shape] = capture
+        else:
+            pass
+        capture.hidden_states.copy_(hidden_states)
+        if capture.valid_key_mask is not None:
+            assert valid_key_mask is not None
+            capture.valid_key_mask.copy_(valid_key_mask)
+        else:
+            pass
+        capture.graph.replay()
+        # note (yhayaran): Later windows and requests must not overwrite results.
+        return capture.output.clone()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Encode Nemotron perception embeddings on a worker before decoder admission."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import queue
+import time
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import MultimodalDataItem
+
+from sglang_omni.models.qwen3_asr.encoder_service import Qwen3ASRPreLMEncoderService
+from sglang_omni.scheduling.pre_lm_encoder import QueueEntry, QueueSignal
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from sglang_omni.models.nemotron_transcribe.sglang_model import (
+        NemotronTranscribeForConditionalGeneration,
+    )
+else:
+    pass
+
+# note (yhayaran): Perception pads a batch to its longest waveform, so long clips encode alone.
+SOLO_WAVEFORM_SECONDS = 60
+_SAMPLE_RATE = 16000
+_LENGTH_RATIO_LIMIT = 4
+
+
+def build_cache_namespace(
+    model: NemotronTranscribeForConditionalGeneration, *, model_path: str
+) -> str:
+    """Digest identifying this process's perception pipeline for cache keying."""
+    config = model.config
+    reference = next(model.perception.parameters())
+    payload = {
+        "model_path": model_path,
+        "perception": config.perception,
+        "pe_encoder_config": config.pe_encoder_config,
+        "audio_token_estimator": config.audio_token_estimator,
+        "dtype": str(reference.dtype),
+        "device_type": reference.device.type,
+        "hidden_size": int(model.perception.proj.out_features),
+    }
+    blob = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, default=str).encode()
+    return hashlib.blake2b(blob, digest_size=8).hexdigest()
+
+
+def waveform_samples(item: MultimodalDataItem) -> int:
+    feature = item.feature
+    if isinstance(feature, torch.Tensor):
+        return int(feature.numel())
+    else:
+        return 0
+
+
+def clips_share_a_batch(first_samples: int, candidate_samples: int) -> bool:
+    solo_samples = SOLO_WAVEFORM_SECONDS * _SAMPLE_RATE
+    if first_samples > solo_samples or candidate_samples > solo_samples:
+        return False
+    else:
+        pass
+    if first_samples <= 0 or candidate_samples <= 0:
+        return True
+    else:
+        pass
+    return max(first_samples, candidate_samples) <= (
+        min(first_samples, candidate_samples) * _LENGTH_RATIO_LIMIT
+    )
+
+
+class NemotronTranscribePreLMEncoderService(Qwen3ASRPreLMEncoderService):
+    """Encode before admission, batching only clips of similar length."""
+
+    ENCODE_TIMEOUT_S = 3600.0
+    MODEL_NAME = "Nemotron Transcribe"
+    WORKER_NAME = "nemotron-transcribe-audio-encode"
+    held: QueueEntry[MultimodalDataItem, torch.Tensor] | None = None
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def encoder_module(
+        model: NemotronTranscribeForConditionalGeneration,
+    ) -> torch.nn.Module:
+        return model.perception
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def output_hidden_size(model: NemotronTranscribeForConditionalGeneration) -> int:
+        return int(model.perception.proj.out_features)
+
+    def next_batch(
+        self,
+    ) -> tuple[list[QueueEntry[MultimodalDataItem, torch.Tensor]], bool]:
+        first = self.held if self.held is not None else self.queue.get()
+        self.held = None
+        if first is QueueSignal.SHUTDOWN:
+            return [], True
+        else:
+            pass
+        batch = [first]
+        solo_samples = SOLO_WAVEFORM_SECONDS * _SAMPLE_RATE
+        if waveform_samples(first.item) > solo_samples:
+            return batch, False
+        else:
+            pass
+        deadline = time.monotonic() + self.max_batch_wait_s
+        shutdown = False
+        first_samples = waveform_samples(first.item)
+        while len(batch) < self.max_batch_size:
+            try:
+                remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
+                queued = (
+                    self.queue.get(timeout=remaining)
+                    if remaining > 0
+                    else self.queue.get_nowait()
+                )
+            except queue.Empty:
+                break
+            if queued is QueueSignal.SHUTDOWN:
+                shutdown = True
+                break
+            else:
+                pass
+            if not clips_share_a_batch(first_samples, waveform_samples(queued.item)):
+                self.held = queued
+                break
+            else:
+                pass
+            batch.append(queued)
+        return batch, shutdown
+
+
+__all__ = [
+    "NemotronTranscribePreLMEncoderService",
+    "build_cache_namespace",
+    "clips_share_a_batch",
+]

+def create_checkpoint_shim(checkpoint_directory: Path) -> Path:
+    checkpoint_directory = checkpoint_directory.resolve()
+    shim_directory = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="sglang-omni-nemotron-transcribe-"))
+    atexit.register(shutil.rmtree, shim_directory, ignore_errors=True)
+    for checkpoint_file in checkpoint_directory.iterdir():
+        if checkpoint_file.name != "config.json":
+            (shim_directory / checkpoint_file.name).symlink_to(checkpoint_file)
+        else:
+            pass
+    return shim_directory

+
+class NemotronTranscribeEngineBuilder(AsrEngineBuilder[NemotronTranscribeRequestData]):
+    model_name = "Nemotron-Transcribe"

+    def __init__(

+    def resolve_checkpoint(self, model_path: str) -> str:

+            "Nemotron Transcribe pre-LM encoder enabled (max_batch=%d, "

+            self.pre_lm_cache_max_entries,

+    def should_wait_for_encode(self) -> bool:

+    def extra_scheduler_callbacks(self) -> dict[str, Callable[[], None]]:

+    def cleanup_build_failure(self) -> None:

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Adapt NeMo SpeechLM configuration to the hybrid NemotronH decoder."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+
+from sglang.srt.configs.nemotron_h import NemotronHConfig
+from transformers import AutoConfig
+
+MODEL_TYPE = "nemotron_transcribe"
+MODEL_ARCH_OVERRIDE = "NemotronTranscribeForConditionalGeneration"
+BACKBONE_ARCH = "NemotronHForCausalLM"
+AUDIO_TOKEN_ID = 131072
+EOS_TOKEN_ID = 11
+
+
+def decode_nemo_floats(value: object) -> object:
+    """Decode JSON float wrappers used for non-finite checkpoint values."""
+    if isinstance(value, dict):
+        if set(value) == {"__float__"}:
+            return float(value["__float__"])
+        else:
+            return {name: decode_nemo_floats(nested) for name, nested in value.items()}
+    elif isinstance(value, list):
+        return [decode_nemo_floats(nested) for nested in value]
+    else:
+        return value
+
+
+class NemotronTranscribeConfig(NemotronHConfig):
+    model_type = MODEL_TYPE
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        perception: dict[str, object] | None = None,
+        pe_encoder_config: dict[str, object] | None = None,
+        audio_token_estimator: dict[str, object] | None = None,
+        audio_token_id: int = AUDIO_TOKEN_ID,
+        **kwargs: object,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(**kwargs)
+        self.perception = dict(perception or {})
+        self.pe_encoder_config = dict(pe_encoder_config or {})
+        self.audio_token_estimator = dict(audio_token_estimator or {})
+        self.audio_token_id = audio_token_id
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_nemo_dict(cls, nemo_config: dict[str, object]) -> NemotronTranscribeConfig:
+        decoder_config = decode_nemo_floats(nemo_config["llm_config"])
+        if not isinstance(decoder_config, dict):
+            raise TypeError("llm_config must be a dictionary")
+        else:
+            pass
+        for name in ("architectures", "model_type", "torch_dtype", "dtype"):
+            decoder_config.pop(name, None)
+        timestep_limits = decoder_config.pop("time_step_limit", None)
+        if timestep_limits is not None:
+            if not isinstance(timestep_limits, list):
+                raise TypeError("time_step_limit must be a list")
+            else:
+                decoder_config["mamba_dt_limit"] = tuple(
+                    float(limit) for limit in timestep_limits
+                )
+        else:
+            pass
+        decoder_config["num_nextn_predict_layers"] = 0
+        eos_token_ids = nemo_config.get("eos_token_id", EOS_TOKEN_ID)
+        if isinstance(eos_token_ids, list):
+            if not eos_token_ids:
+                raise ValueError("eos_token_id must not be empty")
+            else:
+                eos_token_id = eos_token_ids[0]
+        else:
+            eos_token_id = eos_token_ids
+        if not isinstance(eos_token_id, int):
+            raise TypeError("eos_token_id must be an integer")
+        else:
+            decoder_config["eos_token_id"] = eos_token_id
+        perception_config = nemo_config["perception"]
+        encoder_config = nemo_config["pe_encoder_config"]
+        token_estimator = nemo_config.get("audio_token_estimator", {})
+        if (
+            not isinstance(perception_config, dict)
+            or not isinstance(encoder_config, dict)
+            or not isinstance(token_estimator, dict)
+        ):
+            raise TypeError(
+                "perception, pe_encoder_config and audio_token_estimator must be dictionaries"
+            )
+        else:
+            pass
+        # note (yhayaran): NemotronH architecture keeps hybrid cache selection intact.
+        return cls(
+            **decoder_config,
+            architectures=[BACKBONE_ARCH],
+            torch_dtype="bfloat16",
+            perception=perception_config,
+            pe_encoder_config=encoder_config,
+            audio_token_estimator=token_estimator,
+        )
+
+
+def num_audio_frames(
+    num_samples: int, estimator: dict[str, object] | None = None
+) -> int:
+    estimator = estimator or {}
+    preprocessor = estimator.get("preprocessor", {})
+    if not isinstance(preprocessor, dict):
+        raise TypeError("audio_token_estimator.preprocessor must be a dictionary")
+    else:
+        pass
+    fft_samples = preprocessor.get("n_fft", 512)
+    hop_samples = preprocessor.get("hop_length", 160)
+    padding_samples = preprocessor.get("stft_pad_amount", 256)
+    if (
+        not isinstance(fft_samples, int)
+        or not isinstance(hop_samples, int)
+        or not isinstance(padding_samples, int)
+    ):
+        raise TypeError("audio frame geometry must contain integer sample counts")
+    elif fft_samples <= 0 or hop_samples <= 0 or padding_samples < 0:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "audio frame geometry must use positive FFT/hop and nonnegative padding"
+        )
+    else:
+        return max(0, (num_samples + 2 * padding_samples - fft_samples) // hop_samples)
+
+
+def num_audio_tokens(
+    num_samples: int, estimator: dict[str, object] | None = None
+) -> int:
+    """Count audio placeholders after centered STFT and feature stacking."""
+    estimator = estimator or {}
+    subsampling = estimator.get("subsampling", {})
+    if not isinstance(subsampling, dict):
+        raise TypeError("audio_token_estimator.subsampling must be a dictionary")
+    else:
+        pass
+    subsampling_factor = subsampling.get("factor", 8)
+    if not isinstance(subsampling_factor, int) or subsampling_factor <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("audio subsampling factor must be a positive integer")
+    else:
+        return max(
+            1, math.ceil(num_audio_frames(num_samples, estimator) / subsampling_factor)
+        )
+
+
+def register_nemotron_transcribe_hf_config() -> None:
+    AutoConfig.register(MODEL_TYPE, NemotronTranscribeConfig, exist_ok=True)
+
+
+__all__ = [
+    "AUDIO_TOKEN_ID",
+    "EOS_TOKEN_ID",
+    "MODEL_ARCH_OVERRIDE",
+    "NemotronTranscribeConfig",
+    "num_audio_frames",
+    "num_audio_tokens",
+    "register_nemotron_transcribe_hf_config",
+]

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Checkpoint-compatible log-mel features and per-channel normalization."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+STD_FLOOR = 1e-5
+LOG_GUARD = 2.0**-24
+
+
+def normalize_per_feature(
+    features: torch.Tensor, frame_counts: torch.Tensor
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Per-bin mean/variance over valid frames. features is (batch, bins, time)."""
+    batch, _, frames = features.shape
+    if frames == 0:
+        return features
+    else:
+        pass
+    positions = (
+        torch.arange(frames, device=features.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(batch, frames)
+    )
+    valid = positions < frame_counts.unsqueeze(1)
+    denominator = valid.sum(dim=1)
+    reference = features[:, :, 0].masked_fill((denominator == 0).unsqueeze(1), 0.0)
+    centered = torch.where(valid.unsqueeze(1), features - reference.unsqueeze(2), 0.0)
+    mean = reference + centered.sum(dim=2) / denominator.clamp_min(1).unsqueeze(1)
+    squared = torch.where(
+        valid.unsqueeze(1), features - mean.unsqueeze(2), 0.0
+    ).square()
+    std = torch.sqrt(squared.sum(dim=2) / (denominator.unsqueeze(1) - 1.0))
+    std = std.masked_fill(std.isnan(), 0.0) + STD_FLOOR
+    normalized = (features - mean.unsqueeze(2)) / std.unsqueeze(2)
+    return normalized.masked_fill(~valid.unsqueeze(1), 0.0)
+
+
+def normalize_features(
+    features: torch.Tensor, frame_counts: torch.Tensor, mode: str | None
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Apply a frontend normalize mode. NA and None leave features unchanged."""
+    if mode is None or mode in ("", "NA"):
+        return features
+    elif mode == "per_feature":
+        return normalize_per_feature(features, frame_counts)
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"unsupported feature normalize mode {mode!r}")
+
+
+def slaney_mel_filterbank(
+    sample_rate: int, n_fft: int, n_mels: int, fmin: float, fmax: float
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Slaney-normalized mel matrix shaped (1, n_mels, n_fft // 2 + 1)."""
+
+    def hertz_to_mel(frequencies: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        spacing = 200.0 / 3.0
+        log_hertz = 1000.0
+        log_mel = log_hertz / spacing
+        log_step = math.log(6.4) / 27.0
+        linear = frequencies / spacing
+        logarithmic = log_mel + torch.log(frequencies / log_hertz) / log_step
+        return torch.where(frequencies >= log_hertz, logarithmic, linear)
+
+    def mel_to_hertz(mels: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        spacing = 200.0 / 3.0
+        log_hertz = 1000.0
+        log_mel = log_hertz / spacing
+        log_step = math.log(6.4) / 27.0
+        linear = spacing * mels
+        logarithmic = log_hertz * torch.exp(log_step * (mels - log_mel))
+        return torch.where(mels >= log_mel, logarithmic, linear)
+
+    fft_frequencies = torch.linspace(0, sample_rate / 2, n_fft // 2 + 1)
+    mel_points = torch.linspace(
+        hertz_to_mel(torch.tensor(fmin)),
+        hertz_to_mel(torch.tensor(fmax)),
+        n_mels + 2,
+    )
+    hertz_points = mel_to_hertz(mel_points)
+    differences = hertz_points[1:] - hertz_points[:-1]
+    ramps = hertz_points.unsqueeze(1) - fft_frequencies.unsqueeze(0)
+    weights = torch.zeros(n_mels, n_fft // 2 + 1)
+    for index in range(n_mels):
+        lower = -ramps[index] / differences[index]
+        upper = ramps[index + 2] / differences[index + 1]
+        weights[index] = torch.maximum(
+            torch.zeros_like(lower), torch.minimum(lower, upper)
+        )
+    enorm = 2.0 / (hertz_points[2 : n_mels + 2] - hertz_points[:n_mels])
+    return (weights * enorm.unsqueeze(1)).unsqueeze(0)
+
+
+class LogMelFrontend(nn.Module):
+    """Waveform to log-mel. Buffers are named fb and window to match the checkpoint."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        sample_rate: int = 16000,
+        window_size: float = 0.025,
+        window_stride: float = 0.01,
+        n_fft: int = 512,
+        features: int = 128,
+        preemph: float = 0.97,
+        mag_power: float = 2.0,
+        log_zero_guard: float = LOG_GUARD,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.sample_rate = sample_rate
+        self.win_length = int(window_size * sample_rate)
+        self.hop_length = int(window_stride * sample_rate)
+        self.n_fft = n_fft
+        self.preemph = preemph
+        self.mag_power = mag_power
+        self.log_zero_guard = log_zero_guard
+        window = torch.hann_window(self.win_length, periodic=False)
+        self.register_buffer("window", window)
+        banks = slaney_mel_filterbank(
+            sample_rate, n_fft, features, 0.0, sample_rate / 2
+        )
+        self.register_buffer("fb", banks)
+
+    def frame_counts(self, sample_counts: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Valid mel frames for centered STFT, excluding the extra trailing bin."""
+        return torch.div(sample_counts, self.hop_length, rounding_mode="floor")
+
+    def forward(
+        self, waveforms: torch.Tensor, sample_counts: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Return log-mel (batch, bins, time) and valid frame counts."""
+        waveforms = waveforms.to(torch.float32)
+        sample_counts = sample_counts.to(device=waveforms.device)
+        frame_counts = self.frame_counts(sample_counts)
+        if self.preemph:
+            positions = torch.arange(
+                waveforms.shape[1], device=waveforms.device
+            ).unsqueeze(0)
+            valid = positions < sample_counts.unsqueeze(1)
+            emphasized = torch.cat(
+                (waveforms[:, :1], waveforms[:, 1:] - self.preemph * waveforms[:, :-1]),
+                dim=1,
+            )
+            waveforms = emphasized.masked_fill(~valid, 0.0)
+        else:
+            pass
+        with torch.amp.autocast(waveforms.device.type, enabled=False):
+            spectrum = torch.stft(
+                waveforms,
+                n_fft=self.n_fft,
+                hop_length=self.hop_length,
+                win_length=self.win_length,
+                center=True,
+                window=self.window.to(dtype=torch.float32, device=waveforms.device),
+                return_complex=True,
+                pad_mode="constant",
+            )
+        power = torch.view_as_real(spectrum).pow(2).sum(-1).sqrt()
+        if self.mag_power != 1.0:
+            power = power.pow(self.mag_power)
+        else:
+            pass
+        with torch.amp.autocast(waveforms.device.type, enabled=False):
+            mel = torch.matmul(
+                self.fb.to(dtype=power.dtype, device=power.device), power
+            )
+        mel = torch.log(mel + self.log_zero_guard)
+        time = mel.shape[-1]
+        valid = torch.arange(time, device=mel.device).unsqueeze(
+            0
+        ) < frame_counts.unsqueeze(1)
+        mel = mel.masked_fill(~valid.unsqueeze(1), 0.0)
+        return mel.to(self.fb.dtype), frame_counts.to(torch.int64)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Fuse windowed ASR and diarization encoder states."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang_omni.models.nemotron_diarization.speaker_cache import SpeakerCache
+from sglang_omni.models.nemotron_transcribe.mel_features import normalize_features
+from sglang_omni.models.nemotron_transcribe.sortformer_diarizer import (
+    SortformerDiarizer,
+)
+from sglang_omni.models.nemotron_transcribe.speech_transformer import (
+    SpeechTransformerEncoder,
+)
+
+
+def speaker_kernel(speaker_count: int, width: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Sinusoidal speaker table shaped (speakers, width)."""
+    positions = torch.arange(speaker_count, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(1)
+    divider = torch.exp(
+        torch.arange(0, width, 2, dtype=torch.float32) * -(math.log(10000.0) / width)
+    )
+    table = torch.zeros(speaker_count, width, dtype=torch.float32)
+    table[:, 0::2] = torch.sin(positions * divider)
+    table[:, 1::2] = torch.cos(positions * divider)
+    return table
+
+
+def match_module(values: torch.Tensor, module: nn.Module) -> torch.Tensor:
+    parameter = next(module.parameters())
+    return values.to(device=parameter.device, dtype=parameter.dtype)
+
+
+def align_time(activity: torch.Tensor, frames: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Pad by repeating the last frame, or trim, so time matches the ASR chunk."""
+    current = activity.shape[1]
+    if current == frames:
+        return activity
+    elif current == 0:
+        raise ValueError("speaker activity is empty")
+    elif current < frames:
+        return torch.cat(
+            [activity, activity[:, -1:, :].repeat(1, frames - current, 1)], dim=1
+        )
+    else:
+        return activity[:, :frames]
+
+
+class ParallelExpertEncoder(nn.Module):
+    """Fused ASR and diarization encoder. Output is (batch, width, time)."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        asr_encoder: SpeechTransformerEncoder,
+        diarizer: SortformerDiarizer,
+        asr_normalize: str | None,
+        diar_normalize: str | None,
+        speaker_activity_threshold: float,
+        speaker_kernel_scale: float,
+        online_frames: int,
+        left_context_frames: int,
+        right_context_frames: int,
+        cache_limit: int,
+        recent_limit: int,
+        cache_update_frames: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        if asr_encoder.subsampling_factor != diarizer.encoder.subsampling_factor:
+            raise ValueError("ASR and diarization subsampling factors differ")
+        else:
+            pass
+        self.asr_encoder = asr_encoder
+        self.asr_norm = nn.LayerNorm(asr_encoder.d_model)
+        self.diar_norm = nn.LayerNorm(diarizer.sortformer_modules.speakers)
+        self.diarization_model = diarizer
+        self.asr_normalize = asr_normalize
+        self.diar_normalize = diar_normalize
+        self.speaker_activity_threshold = speaker_activity_threshold
+        self.speaker_kernel_scale = speaker_kernel_scale
+        self.online_frames = online_frames
+        self.left_context_frames = left_context_frames
+        self.right_context_frames = right_context_frames
+        self.cache_limit = cache_limit
+        self.recent_limit = recent_limit
+        self.cache_update_frames = cache_update_frames
+        self.register_buffer(
+            "diar_kernel",
+            speaker_kernel(diarizer.sortformer_modules.speakers, asr_encoder.d_model),
+            persistent=False,
+        )
+
+    @property
+    def subsampling_factor(self) -> int:
+        return self.asr_encoder.subsampling_factor
+
+    def forward(
+        self, mel: torch.Tensor, mel_lengths: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """mel is (batch, bins, time). Returns fused states and encoder frame counts."""
+        mel_lengths = mel_lengths.to(device=mel.device, dtype=torch.long)
+        asr_mel = match_module(
+            normalize_features(mel, mel_lengths, self.asr_normalize), self.asr_encoder
+        )
+        diar_mel = match_module(
+            normalize_features(mel, mel_lengths, self.diar_normalize),
+            self.diarization_model.encoder,
+        )
+        speakers = self.diarization_model.sortformer_modules.speakers
+        batch = mel.shape[0]
+        state = SpeakerCache(
+            diar_mel,
+            cache_size=self.cache_limit,
+            fifo_size=self.recent_limit,
+            update_period=self.cache_update_frames,
+            batch=batch,
+            width=self.diarization_model.encoder.d_model,
+            speakers=speakers,
+        )
+        total = torch.zeros(
+            (batch, 0, speakers),
+            device=diar_mel.device,
+            dtype=diar_mel.dtype,
+        )
+        limit = min(mel.shape[-1], int(mel_lengths.max().item()))
+        chunk_frames = self.online_frames * self.subsampling_factor
+        left_frames = self.left_context_frames * self.subsampling_factor
+        right_frames = self.right_context_frames * self.subsampling_factor
+        chunk_count = max(1, math.ceil(limit / chunk_frames)) if chunk_frames else 1
+        asr_parts: list[torch.Tensor] = []
+        diar_parts: list[torch.Tensor] = []
+        for index in range(chunk_count):
+            start = index * chunk_frames
+            end = min(start + chunk_frames, limit)
+            context_start = max(start - left_frames, 0)
+            context_end = min(end + right_frames, limit)
+            left_offset = start - context_start
+            right_offset = context_end - end
+            asr_lengths = (mel_lengths - context_start).clamp(
+                min=0, max=context_end - context_start
+            )
+            encoded, _ = self.asr_encoder(
+                asr_mel[:, :, context_start:context_end], asr_lengths
+            )
+            left_drop = left_offset // self.subsampling_factor
+            core = self.output_frames(end) - self.output_frames(start)
+            core = max(0, min(core, encoded.shape[-1] - left_drop))
+            asr_parts.append(encoded[:, :, left_drop : left_drop + core])
+            previous = total.shape[1]
+            total = self.diarization_model.streaming_step(
+                state,
+                total,
+                diar_mel[:, :, context_start:context_end],
+                asr_lengths.to(diar_mel.device),
+                left_offset,
+                right_offset,
+            )
+            diar_parts.append(align_time(total[:, previous:], core))
+        fused = self.fuse(torch.cat(asr_parts, dim=2), torch.cat(diar_parts, dim=1))
+        return fused, self.encoded_lengths(mel_lengths, mel.shape[-1])
+
+    def output_frames(self, mel_frames: int) -> int:
+        return (mel_frames + self.subsampling_factor - 1) // self.subsampling_factor
+
+    def encoded_lengths(
+        self, mel_lengths: torch.Tensor, mel_frames: int
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        valid = mel_lengths.clamp(min=0, max=mel_frames)
+        return torch.div(
+            valid + self.subsampling_factor - 1,
+            self.subsampling_factor,
+            rounding_mode="floor",
+        )
+
+    def fuse(self, asr_encoded: torch.Tensor, activity: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """asr_encoded is (batch, width, time). activity is (batch, time, speakers)."""
+        states = asr_encoded.transpose(1, 2)
+        activity = align_time(activity, states.shape[1]).to(
+            device=states.device, dtype=states.dtype
+        )
+        speaker_features = (activity > self.speaker_activity_threshold).to(states.dtype)
+        infusion = self.diar_norm(speaker_features) @ self.diar_kernel.to(
+            dtype=states.dtype
+        )
+        fused = self.asr_norm(states) + self.speaker_kernel_scale * infusion
+        return fused.transpose(1, 2).contiguous()

+def load_perception_weights(

+def build_frontend(config: dict[str, object]) -> LogMelFrontend:

+        rotary_fraction=read_float(config, "rotary_fraction", rotary_fraction),
+        pos_emb_max_len=read_int(config, "pos_emb_max_len", 5000),
+    )
+
+
+SORTFORMER_SCORING = {
+    "spkcache_sil_frames_per_spk": 1,
+    "pred_score_threshold": 0.25,
+    "scores_boost_latest": 0.05,
+    "strong_boost_rate": 0.75,
+    "weak_boost_rate": 1.5,
+    "min_pos_scores_rate": 0.5,
+}
+
+
+def build_sortformer(
+    config: dict[str, object], upsample_factor: int
+) -> SortformerModules:
+    if not read_bool(config, "use_learnable_sil_emb", False):
+        raise ValueError("only the learned silence embedding is supported")
+    else:
+        pass
+    for name, supported in SORTFORMER_SCORING.items():
+        if read_float(config, name, supported) != supported:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"unsupported sortformer_modules {name}, expected {supported}"
+            )
+        else:
+            pass
+    return SortformerModules(
+        fc_d_model=read_int(config, "fc_d_model", 512),
+        tf_d_model=read_int(config, "tf_d_model", 192),
+        speakers=read_int(config, "num_spks", 8),
+        upsample=upsample_factor,
+    )
+
+
+def expect_dict(value: object, label: str) -> dict[str, object]:
+    if isinstance(value, dict):
+        return value
+    else:
+        raise TypeError(f"{label} must be a dict, got {type(value).__name__}")
+
+
+def optional_text(config: dict[str, object], key: str) -> str | None:
+    if key not in config or config[key] is None:
+        return None
+    else:
+        return str(config[key])
+
+
+def read_int(config: dict[str, object], key: str, default: int) -> int:
+    value = config.get(key, default)
+    if value is None:
+        return default
+    elif isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+        raise TypeError(f"{key} must be an integer")
+    else:
+        return int(value)
+
+
+def read_float(config: dict[str, object], key: str, default: float) -> float:
+    value = config.get(key, default)
+    if value is None:
+        return default
+    elif isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+        raise TypeError(f"{key} must be a number")
+    else:
+        return float(value)
+
+
+def read_bool(config: dict[str, object], key: str, default: bool) -> bool:
+    value = config.get(key, default)
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        return value
+    else:
+        raise TypeError(f"{key} must be a boolean")
