+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Build Nemotron Transcribe requests and decoded text responses."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import time
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Protocol
+
+import torch
+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import (
+    Modality,
+    MultimodalDataItem,
+    MultimodalInputs,
+    Req,
+)
+from sglang.srt.sampling.sampling_params import SamplingParams
+from transformers import PreTrainedTokenizerBase
+
+from sglang_omni.models.nemotron_transcribe.encoder_service import (
+    NemotronTranscribePreLMEncoderService,
+)
+from sglang_omni.models.nemotron_transcribe.hf_config import (
+    AUDIO_TOKEN_ID,
+    EOS_TOKEN_ID,
+    num_audio_frames,
+    num_audio_tokens,
+)
+from sglang_omni.preprocessing.transcription import prepare_audio
+from sglang_omni.proto.request import StagePayload
+from sglang_omni.scheduling.sglang_backend.request_data import SGLangARRequestData
+from sglang_omni.scheduling.token_text_streaming import (
+    make_token_text_stream_output_builder,
+)
+from sglang_omni.scheduling.types import DeferredAdmission, StreamOutputBuilder
+
+SAMPLE_RATE = 16000
+AUDIO_TOKEN = "<|audio|>"
+DEFAULT_PROMPT = (
+    "Produce a verbatim transcript of the audio. Preserve named entities, "
+    "abbreviations, numbers, dates, measurements, acronyms, and technical terms "
+    "as clearly as possible. Keep the same language as spoken and do not translate."
+)
+
+
+@dataclass
+class NemotronTranscribeRequestData(SGLangARRequestData):
+    prompt_token_ids: list[int] | None = None
+    output_ids: list[int] | None = None
+    audio_duration_s: float = 0.0
+    language: str | None = None
+    engine_start_s: float = 0.0
+
+
+class RequestBuilder(Protocol):
+    def __call__(
+        self, payload: StagePayload
+    ) -> (
+        NemotronTranscribeRequestData | DeferredAdmission[NemotronTranscribeRequestData]
+    ): ...
+
+
+class ResultAdapter(Protocol):
+    def __call__(self, request_data: NemotronTranscribeRequestData) -> StagePayload: ...
+
+
+def render_prompt_ids(
+    tokenizer: PreTrainedTokenizerBase,
+    instruction: str,
+    system_prompt: str = "",
+) -> list[int]:
+    messages = []
+    if system_prompt:
+        messages.append({"role": "system", "content": system_prompt})
+    else:
+        pass
+    messages.append({"role": "user", "content": f"{AUDIO_TOKEN}\n{instruction}"})
+    text = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
+        messages,
+        tokenize=False,
+        add_generation_prompt=True,
+        enable_thinking=False,
+    )
+    return list(tokenizer(text, add_special_tokens=False).input_ids)
+
+
+def decode_tokens(tokenizer: PreTrainedTokenizerBase, ids: list[int]) -> str:
+    return tokenizer.decode(
+        ids, skip_special_tokens=False, clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False
+    )
+
+
+def make_scheduler_adapters(
+    *,
+    tokenizer: PreTrainedTokenizerBase,
+    max_new_tokens: int,
+    audio_token_estimator: dict[str, object] | None = None,
+    audio_token_id: int = AUDIO_TOKEN_ID,
+    eos_token_id: int = EOS_TOKEN_ID,
+    max_audio_seconds: float | None = None,
+    vocab_size: int = AUDIO_TOKEN_ID,
+    audio_encoder_service: NemotronTranscribePreLMEncoderService | None = None,
+    should_wait_for_encode: Callable[[], bool] | None = None,
+) -> tuple[
+    RequestBuilder,
+    ResultAdapter,
+]:
+    def request_builder(
+        payload: StagePayload,
+    ) -> (
+        NemotronTranscribeRequestData | DeferredAdmission[NemotronTranscribeRequestData]
+    ):
+        params = payload.request.params or {}
+        prepared = prepare_audio(
+            payload,
+            source_name="Nemotron Transcribe",
+            target_sample_rate=SAMPLE_RATE,
+            max_duration_s=max_audio_seconds,
+        )
+        waveform = torch.from_numpy(prepared.waveform).float()
+        if num_audio_frames(waveform.numel(), audio_token_estimator) < 2:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Nemotron Transcribe requires at least two valid mel frames"
+            )
+        else:
+            n_audio = num_audio_tokens(waveform.numel(), audio_token_estimator)
+        cached_embedding = None
+        if audio_encoder_service is not None:
+            cached_embedding = audio_encoder_service.lookup_cached_embedding(
+                prepared.fingerprint, n_audio
+            )
+        else:
+            pass
+
+        instruction = str(params.get("prompt") or DEFAULT_PROMPT)
+        prompt_ids = render_prompt_ids(
+            tokenizer, instruction, str(params.get("system_prompt") or "")
+        )
+        if prompt_ids.count(audio_token_id) != 1:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Nemotron Transcribe prompt must contain exactly one <|audio|> token"
+            )
+        else:
+            pass
+        audio_start = prompt_ids.index(audio_token_id)
+
+        audio_item = MultimodalDataItem(
+            modality=Modality.AUDIO,
+            hash=prepared.fingerprint_int,
+            feature=None if cached_embedding is not None else waveform,
+            model_specific_data={
+                "num_audio_tokens": n_audio,
+                "audio_fingerprint": prepared.fingerprint,
+            },
+        )
+        audio_item.set_pad_value()
+        input_ids = (
+            prompt_ids[:audio_start]
+            + [audio_item.pad_value] * n_audio
+            + prompt_ids[audio_start + 1 :]
+        )
+        audio_item.offsets = [(audio_start, audio_start + n_audio - 1)]
+        mm_inputs = MultimodalInputs(mm_items=[audio_item], num_image_tokens=n_audio)
+        mm_inputs.audio_token_id = audio_token_id
+
+        request_max_new_tokens = int(params.get("max_new_tokens") or max_new_tokens)
+        temperature = float(params.get("temperature") or 0.0)
+        sampling_params = SamplingParams(
+            max_new_tokens=request_max_new_tokens,
+            temperature=temperature,
+            top_p=float(params.get("top_p") or 1.0),
+            stop_token_ids=[int(eos_token_id)],
+        )
+        sampling_params.normalize(tokenizer=None)
+
+        req = Req(
+            rid=payload.request_id,
+            origin_input_text="",
+            origin_input_ids=input_ids,
+            sampling_params=sampling_params,
+            vocab_size=vocab_size,
+            extra_key=prepared.fingerprint,
+        )
+        req.multimodal_inputs = mm_inputs
+
+        if cached_embedding is not None:
+            audio_encoder_service.attach_embedding(audio_item, cached_embedding)
+        else:
+            pass
+        req_data = NemotronTranscribeRequestData(
+            input_ids=torch.tensor(input_ids, dtype=torch.long),
+            req=req,
+            prompt_token_ids=input_ids,
+            max_new_tokens=request_max_new_tokens,
+            temperature=temperature,
+            audio_duration_s=prepared.duration_s,
+            language=params.get("language"),
+            engine_start_s=time.perf_counter(),
+            stage_payload=payload,
+        )
+        if audio_encoder_service is None or cached_embedding is not None:
+            return req_data
+        else:
+            pass
+        # note (yhayaran): Waiting while a build worker is free keeps a failed encode's timeout.
+        if should_wait_for_encode is not None and should_wait_for_encode():
+            audio_encoder_service.encode_item(audio_item)
+            return req_data
+        else:
+            pass
+        return DeferredAdmission(
+            value=req_data,
+            ready=audio_encoder_service.submit_item(audio_item),
+        )
+
+    def result_adapter(data: NemotronTranscribeRequestData) -> StagePayload:
+        payload = data.stage_payload
+        assert payload is not None
+        output_ids = [t for t in (data.output_ids or []) if t != eos_token_id]
+        text = decode_tokens(tokenizer, output_ids).strip()
+        engine_time_s = (
+            time.perf_counter() - data.engine_start_s if data.engine_start_s else 0.0
+        )
+        return StagePayload(
+            request_id=payload.request_id,
+            request=payload.request,
+            data={
+                "text": text,
+                "language": data.language,
+                "duration_s": data.audio_duration_s,
+                "asr_latency_s": engine_time_s,
+                "finish_reason": data.finish_reason,
+                "usage": {
+                    "engine_time_s": engine_time_s,
+                    "prompt_tokens": len(data.prompt_token_ids or []),
+                    "completion_tokens": len(output_ids),
+                },
+                "modality": "text",
+            },
+        )
+
+    return request_builder, result_adapter
+
+
+def make_stream_output_builder(
+    tokenizer: PreTrainedTokenizerBase,
+    min_emit_interval_s: float,
+    eos_token_id: int,
+) -> StreamOutputBuilder[SGLangARRequestData]:
+    return make_token_text_stream_output_builder(
+        decode_fn=lambda ids: decode_tokens(
+            tokenizer, [t for t in ids if t != eos_token_id]
+        ),
+        build_message_data=lambda delta: {
+            "text": delta,
+            "modality": "text",
+            "stage_name": "asr",
+        },
+        build_message_metadata=lambda token_id: {
+            "modality": "text",
+            "token_id": token_id,
+        },
+        pending_ids_attr="nemotron_transcribe_stream_pending_ids",
+        last_emit_attr="nemotron_transcribe_stream_last_emit_seconds",
+        eos_token_id=eos_token_id,
+        min_emit_interval_s=min_emit_interval_s,
+        allow_terminal_flush=True,
+        emit_trailing_replacement_on_terminal=True,
+    )
+
+
+__all__ = [
+    "DEFAULT_PROMPT",
+    "NemotronTranscribeRequestData",
+    "make_scheduler_adapters",
+    "make_stream_output_builder",
+    "render_prompt_ids",
+]

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Native perception embeddings and the SGLang NemotronH language decoder."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+from collections.abc import Iterable, Iterator
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn as nn
+from sglang.srt.distributed.parallel_state import GroupCoordinator
+from sglang.srt.layers.logits_processor import LogitsProcessorOutput
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.base_config import QuantizationConfig
+from sglang.srt.managers.mm_utils import (
+    MultiModalityDataPaddingPatternMultimodalTokens,
+    general_mm_embed_routine,
+)
+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import (
+    Modality,
+    MultimodalDataItem,
+    MultimodalInputs,
+)
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardBatch
+from sglang.srt.models.nemotron_h import NemotronHForCausalLM
+from sglang.srt.utils import add_prefix
+
+from sglang_omni.models.nemotron_transcribe.checkpoint_contract import (
+    classify_checkpoint_name,
+)
+from sglang_omni.models.nemotron_transcribe.decoder_weights import (
+    checkpoint_to_language_model_weights,
+)
+from sglang_omni.models.nemotron_transcribe.hf_config import NemotronTranscribeConfig
+from sglang_omni.models.nemotron_transcribe.perception import (
+    AudioPerception,
+    build_audio_perception,
+    load_perception_weights,
+)
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+PERCEPTION_DTYPE = torch.bfloat16
+
+
+def build_perception(config: NemotronTranscribeConfig) -> AudioPerception:
+    """Build the native perception module from the checkpoint config sections."""
+    if not config.pe_encoder_config:
+        raise ValueError("Nemotron Transcribe checkpoint has no pe_encoder_config")
+    else:
+        pass
+    return build_audio_perception(config.perception, config.pe_encoder_config)
+
+
+class NemotronTranscribeForConditionalGeneration(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: NemotronTranscribeConfig,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.config = config
+        self.audio_token_id = int(config.audio_token_id)
+        self.perception = build_perception(config)
+        self.language_model = NemotronHForCausalLM(
+            config=config,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=add_prefix("language_model", prefix),
+        )
+        self.pattern = MultiModalityDataPaddingPatternMultimodalTokens()
+        self.encoder_max_batch_size: int | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def pp_group(self) -> GroupCoordinator:
+        return self.language_model.pp_group
+
+    def get_input_embeddings(self) -> nn.Module:
+        return self.language_model.get_input_embeddings()
+
+    def pad_input_ids(
+        self, input_ids: list[int], mm_inputs: MultimodalInputs
+    ) -> list[int]:
+        return self.pattern.pad_input_tokens(input_ids, mm_inputs)
+
+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def get_audio_feature(self, items: list[MultimodalDataItem]) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Encode audio items in bounded batches; output follows item order."""
+        assert self.encoder_max_batch_size is not None
+        outputs = []
+        for start in range(0, len(items), self.encoder_max_batch_size):
+            outputs.extend(
+                self.encode_audio_batch(
+                    items[start : start + self.encoder_max_batch_size]
+                )
+            )
+        return torch.cat(outputs, dim=0)
+
+    def encode_audio_batch(self, items: list[MultimodalDataItem]) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
+        device = next(self.perception.parameters()).device
+        waves = [
+            torch.as_tensor(item.feature).reshape(-1).to(device, torch.float32)
+            for item in items
+        ]
+        lengths = torch.tensor([w.numel() for w in waves], device=device)
+        batch = torch.zeros(
+            len(waves), max(wave.numel() for wave in waves), device=device
+        )
+        for i, wave in enumerate(waves):
+            batch[i, : wave.numel()] = wave
+
+        embs, emb_lens = self.perception(
+            input_signal=batch, input_signal_length=lengths
+        )
+
+        outputs = []
+        for i, item in enumerate(items):
+            expected = int(item.model_specific_data["num_audio_tokens"])
+            emb = embs[i, : int(emb_lens[i])].to(PERCEPTION_DTYPE)
+            if emb.shape[0] != expected:
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    f"Audio encoder produced {emb.shape[0]} embeddings for {expected} placeholders"
+                )
+            else:
+                pass
+            outputs.append(emb)
+        return outputs
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        forward_batch: ForwardBatch,
+        **kwargs: object,
+    ) -> LogitsProcessorOutput:
+        # note (yhayaran): get_audio_feature runs here only when the pre-LM encoder is disabled.
+        return general_mm_embed_routine(
+            input_ids=input_ids,
+            forward_batch=forward_batch,
+            language_model=self.language_model,
+            data_embedding_funcs={Modality.AUDIO: self.get_audio_feature},
+            positions=positions,
+        )
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> None:
+        perception_weights: dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
+
+        def language_model_weights() -> Iterator[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]:
+            for name, tensor in weights:
+                kind, parameter_name = classify_checkpoint_name(name)
+                if kind == "perception":
+                    perception_weights[parameter_name] = tensor
+                elif kind == "skip":
+                    continue
+                else:
+                    yield name, tensor
+
+        self.language_model.load_weights(
+            checkpoint_to_language_model_weights(language_model_weights())
+        )
+
+        load_perception_weights(self.perception, perception_weights, PERCEPTION_DTYPE)
+        logger.info(f"Loaded {len(perception_weights)} perception tensors")
+
+
+EntryClass = NemotronTranscribeForConditionalGeneration

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Windowed Sortformer inference on the ASR frame grid."""
+
+import math
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang_omni.models.nemotron_diarization.model import SortformerModules
+from sglang_omni.models.nemotron_diarization.speaker_cache import SpeakerCache
+from sglang_omni.models.nemotron_transcribe.speech_transformer import (
+    SpeechTransformerEncoder,
+)
+
+
+def downsample_preds(predictions: torch.Tensor, factor: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Average non-overlapping speaker-probability windows. predictions is (batch, time, speakers)."""
+    if factor == 1 or predictions.shape[1] == 0:
+        return predictions
+    else:
+        pass
+    pooled = F.avg_pool1d(
+        predictions.transpose(1, 2),
+        kernel_size=factor,
+        stride=factor,
+        ceil_mode=True,
+        count_include_pad=False,
+    )
+    return pooled.transpose(1, 2)
+
+
+class SortformerDiarizer(nn.Module):
+    """Mel chunk to speaker probabilities on the ASR frame grid."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        encoder: SpeechTransformerEncoder,
+        modules: SortformerModules,
+        output_subsampling_factor: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.encoder = encoder
+        self.sortformer_modules = modules
+        self.downsample_factor = output_subsampling_factor
+
+    def streaming_step(
+        self,
+        state: SpeakerCache,
+        total_predictions: torch.Tensor,
+        mel_chunk: torch.Tensor,
+        mel_lengths: torch.Tensor,
+        left_offset: int,
+        right_offset: int,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """mel_chunk is (batch, bins, time). Returns predictions concatenated on time."""
+        modules = self.sortformer_modules
+        pre_encoded, pre_lengths = self.encoder.pre_encode(mel_chunk, mel_lengths)
+        left_frames = round(left_offset / self.encoder.subsampling_factor)
+        right_frames = math.ceil(right_offset / self.encoder.subsampling_factor)
+        core = pre_encoded.shape[1] - left_frames - right_frames
+        if core < 0:
+            raise ValueError("streaming chunk is shorter than its context")
+        else:
+            pass
+        prefix = state.cache.shape[1] + state.fifo.shape[1]
+        combined = torch.cat([state.cache, state.fifo, pre_encoded], dim=1)
+        encoded, encoded_lengths = self.encoder(
+            combined, prefix + pre_lengths, bypass_pre_encode=True
+        )
+        high_predictions = modules(
+            encoded.transpose(1, 2), encoded_lengths.unsqueeze(1)
+        )
+        state_predictions = self.mask_predictions(
+            downsample_preds(high_predictions, modules.upsample).detach(),
+            encoded_lengths,
+        )
+        state.update(
+            pre_encoded[:, left_frames : left_frames + core],
+            torch.cat(
+                [
+                    state_predictions[:, :prefix],
+                    state_predictions[:, prefix + left_frames :],
+                ],
+                dim=1,
+            ),
+            modules.learnable_sil_emb,
+        )
+        start = (prefix + left_frames) * modules.upsample
+        chunk_predictions = high_predictions[:, start : start + core * modules.upsample]
+        chunk_predictions = downsample_preds(chunk_predictions, self.downsample_factor)
+        return torch.cat([total_predictions, chunk_predictions], dim=1)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def mask_predictions(
+        predictions: torch.Tensor, lengths: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        batch, frames, speakers = predictions.shape
+        positions = torch.arange(frames, device=predictions.device).view(1, -1, 1)
+        keep = positions.expand(batch, -1, speakers) < lengths.view(-1, 1, 1)
+        return torch.where(
+            keep,
+            predictions,
+            torch.zeros((), device=predictions.device, dtype=predictions.dtype),
+        )

+"""Speech transformer with feature stacking, rotary positions and encoder compilation."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from torch import nn
+from torch._dynamo import config as dynamo_config
+
+from sglang_omni.models.nemotron_transcribe.config import EncoderCompileMode
+from sglang_omni.models.nemotron_transcribe.encoder_cuda_graph import (
+    EncoderCudaGraphs,
+    EncoderLayersForward,
+)
+
+ENCODER_RECOMPILE_LIMIT = 64
+
+
+class FeatureStacking(nn.Module):
+    """Stack subsampling_factor frames and project. proj has no bias."""
+
+    def __init__(self, subsampling_factor: int, feat_in: int, feat_out: int) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.subsampling_factor = subsampling_factor
+        self.proj = nn.Linear(subsampling_factor * feat_in, feat_out, bias=False)
+
+    def forward(
+        self, features: torch.Tensor, lengths: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """features is (batch, channels, time). Returns (batch, time', width)."""
+        sequence = features.transpose(1, 2)
+        batch, frames, channels = sequence.shape
+        pad_frames = (
+            self.subsampling_factor - frames % self.subsampling_factor
+        ) % self.subsampling_factor
+        if pad_frames:
+            sequence = F.pad(sequence, (0, 0, 0, pad_frames))
+        else:
+            pass
+        grouped = sequence.reshape(batch, -1, channels * self.subsampling_factor)
+        output_lengths = (
+            lengths + self.subsampling_factor - 1
+        ) // self.subsampling_factor
+        return self.proj(grouped), output_lengths
+
+
+class RotaryEmbedding(nn.Module):
+    """Rotary positions with CPU-computed frequencies and non-checkpoint buffers."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, head_dim: int, rotary_fraction: float, rope_base: float, max_length: int
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        rotary_dim = int(head_dim * rotary_fraction)
+        if rotary_dim < 2 or rotary_dim % 2 != 0:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"rotary dimension must be a positive even number, got {rotary_dim}"
+            )
+        else:
+            pass
+        self.rotary_dim = rotary_dim
+        # note (yhayaran): SGLang builds this under a CUDA default device, so pin factories to CPU.
+        inv_freq = 1.0 / (
+            rope_base
+            ** (
+                torch.arange(0, rotary_dim, 2, dtype=torch.float32, device="cpu")
+                / rotary_dim
+            )
+        )
+        self.register_buffer("inv_freq", inv_freq, persistent=False)
+        self.register_buffer("cos", torch.empty(0, device="cpu"), persistent=False)
+        self.register_buffer("sin", torch.empty(0, device="cpu"), persistent=False)
+        self.extend(max_length)
+
+    def extend(self, length: int) -> None:
+        if self.cos.numel() and self.cos.shape[0] >= length:
+            return
+        else:
+            pass
+        device = self.inv_freq.device
+        positions = torch.arange(length, dtype=torch.float32, device="cpu")
+        frequencies = torch.outer(
+            positions, self.inv_freq.detach().to(dtype=torch.float32, device="cpu")
+        )
+        embeddings = torch.cat((frequencies, frequencies), dim=-1)
+        self.cos = embeddings.cos().to(device)
+        self.sin = embeddings.sin().to(device)
+
+    def apply_rotary(
+        self, queries: torch.Tensor, keys: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Rotate equal-length (batch, heads, time, dim) queries and keys."""
+        frames = keys.shape[2]
+        self.extend(frames)
+        if self.cos.device != queries.device:
+            self.cos = self.cos.to(device=queries.device)
+            self.sin = self.sin.to(device=queries.device)
+        else:
+            pass
+        cos = self.cos[:frames]
+        sin = self.sin[:frames]
+        return self.rotate(queries, cos, sin), self.rotate(keys, cos, sin)
+
+    def rotate(
+        self, tokens: torch.Tensor, cos: torch.Tensor, sin: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        cos = cos.view(1, 1, cos.shape[0], self.rotary_dim).to(tokens.dtype)
+        sin = sin.view(1, 1, sin.shape[0], self.rotary_dim).to(tokens.dtype)
+        if self.rotary_dim == tokens.shape[-1]:
+            rotated = tokens
+            rest = None
+        else:
+            rotated = tokens[..., : self.rotary_dim]
+            rest = tokens[..., self.rotary_dim :]
+        half = rotated.shape[-1] // 2
+        twisted = torch.cat((-rotated[..., half:], rotated[..., :half]), dim=-1)
+        rotated = rotated * cos + twisted * sin
+        if rest is None:
+            return rotated
+        else:
+            return torch.cat((rotated, rest), dim=-1)
+
+
+class FeedForward(nn.Module):
+    """GELU feed-forward. Sequential indexes 0 and 3 are the linears."""
+
+    def __init__(self, model_dim: int, expansion: float, drop_rate: float) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        hidden = int(expansion * model_dim)
+        self.net = nn.Sequential(
+            nn.Linear(model_dim, hidden),
+            nn.GELU(),
+            nn.Dropout(drop_rate),
+            nn.Linear(hidden, model_dim),
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, hidden: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.net(hidden)
+
+
+class SpeechAttention(nn.Module):
+    """Fused QKV attention. q_norm and k_norm exist only when qk_norm is set."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        model_dim: int,
+        head_count: int,
+        qkv_bias: bool,
+        qk_norm: bool,
+        rope: RotaryEmbedding | None,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        if model_dim % head_count != 0:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"model dim {model_dim} is not divisible by {head_count} heads"
+            )
+        else:
+            pass
+        self.head_count = head_count
+        self.head_dim = model_dim // head_count
+        self.model_dim = model_dim
+        self.rope = rope
+        self.w_qkv = nn.Linear(model_dim, 3 * model_dim, bias=qkv_bias)
+        self.out_proj = nn.Linear(model_dim, model_dim)
+        if qk_norm:
+            self.q_norm = nn.LayerNorm(self.head_dim)
+            self.k_norm = nn.LayerNorm(self.head_dim)
+        else:
+            self.q_norm = None
+            self.k_norm = None
+
+    def forward(
+        self, hidden: torch.Tensor, key_keep: torch.Tensor | None
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """key_keep is (batch, time) True where the key is valid. None means every frame is valid."""
+        batch, frames, _ = hidden.shape
+        mixed = self.w_qkv(hidden).view(
+            batch, frames, 3, self.head_count, self.head_dim
+        )
+        queries, keys, values = mixed.permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4).unbind(0)
+        if self.q_norm is not None and self.k_norm is not None:
+            queries = self.q_norm(queries).to(values.dtype)
+            keys = self.k_norm(keys).to(values.dtype)
+        else:
+            pass
+        if self.rope is not None:
+            queries, keys = self.rope.apply_rotary(queries, keys)
+        else:
+            pass
+        if key_keep is None:
+            attended = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(queries, keys, values)
+        else:
+            attended = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
+                queries, keys, values, attn_mask=key_keep.view(batch, 1, 1, frames)
+            )
+        attended = (
+            attended.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(batch, frames, self.model_dim)
+        )
+        return self.out_proj(attended)
+
+
+class SpeechTransformerBlock(nn.Module):
+    """Pre-norm residual block."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        model_dim: int,
+        head_count: int,
+        expansion: float,
+        drop_rate: float,
+        qkv_bias: bool,
+        qk_norm: bool,
+        rope: RotaryEmbedding | None,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(model_dim)
+        self.attn = SpeechAttention(model_dim, head_count, qkv_bias, qk_norm, rope)
+        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
+        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(model_dim)
+        self.ffn = FeedForward(model_dim, expansion, drop_rate)
+
+    def forward(
+        self, hidden: torch.Tensor, key_keep: torch.Tensor | None
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        hidden = hidden + self.dropout(self.attn(self.norm1(hidden), key_keep))
+        hidden = hidden + self.dropout(self.ffn(self.norm2(hidden)))
+        return hidden
+
+
+class SpeechTransformerEncoder(nn.Module):
+    """Feature stacking, rotary pre-norm stack, channels-first output."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        feat_in: int,
+        d_model: int,
+        n_heads: int,
+        n_layers: int,
+        subsampling_factor: int = 8,
+        drop_rate: float = 0.1,
+        qkv_bias: bool = False,
+        qk_norm: bool = False,
+        ff_expansion: float = 4.0,
+        pre_block_norm: bool = True,
+        rope_base: float = 10000.0,
+        rotary_fraction: float = 1.0,
+        pos_emb_max_len: int = 5000,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.d_model = d_model
+        self.subsampling_factor = subsampling_factor
+        self.pre_encode = FeatureStacking(subsampling_factor, feat_in, d_model)
+        self.dropout_pre_encoder = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
+        head_dim = d_model // n_heads
+        self.pos_enc = RotaryEmbedding(
+            head_dim, rotary_fraction, rope_base, pos_emb_max_len
+        )
+        if pre_block_norm:
+            self.embed_norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
+        else:
+            self.embed_norm = nn.Identity()
+        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
+            [
+                SpeechTransformerBlock(
+                    d_model,
+                    n_heads,
+                    ff_expansion,
+                    drop_rate,
+                    qkv_bias,
+                    qk_norm,
+                    self.pos_enc,
+                )
+                for _ in range(n_layers)
+            ]
+        )
+        self.final_norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
+        self.compiled_layers: EncoderLayersForward | None = None
+
+    def forward_layers(
+        self, hidden: torch.Tensor, key_keep: torch.Tensor | None
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        for layer in self.layers:
+            hidden = layer(hidden, key_keep)
+        return self.final_norm(hidden)
+
+    def compile_layers(
+        self,
+        mode: EncoderCompileMode = "default",
+        cuda_graphs: bool = False,
+        dynamic: bool = False,
+    ) -> None:
+        # note (yhayaran): Encoder-owned graphs avoid Inductor/decoder pool conflicts.
+        compiled = torch.compile(
+            self.forward_layers, mode=mode, fullgraph=False, dynamic=dynamic
+        )
+        self.compiled_layers = EncoderCudaGraphs(compiled) if cuda_graphs else compiled
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        audio_signal: torch.Tensor,
+        length: torch.Tensor,
+        bypass_pre_encode: bool = False,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Map (batch, bins, time), or (batch, time, width) with bypass, to (batch, width, time)."""
+        if bypass_pre_encode:
+            hidden = audio_signal
+            lengths = length.to(torch.int64)
+        else:
+            hidden, lengths = self.pre_encode(audio_signal, length)
+            lengths = lengths.to(torch.int64)
+        hidden = self.dropout_pre_encoder(hidden)
+        hidden = self.embed_norm(hidden)
+        frames = hidden.shape[1]
+        # note (yhayaran): A bool mask disables flash attention, so full windows skip it.
+        if bool(torch.all(lengths >= frames).item()):
+            key_keep = None
+        else:
+            positions = torch.arange(frames, device=hidden.device)
+            key_keep = positions.unsqueeze(0) < lengths.unsqueeze(1).clamp(max=frames)
+        if self.compiled_layers is None:
+            hidden = self.forward_layers(hidden, key_keep)
+        else:
+            # note (yhayaran): The patch is thread-local and covers concurrent batch and padding shapes.
+            with dynamo_config.patch(recompile_limit=ENCODER_RECOMPILE_LIMIT):
+                hidden = self.compiled_layers(hidden, key_keep)
+        return hidden.transpose(1, 2).contiguous(), lengths

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Triton pointwise kernels for contiguous PersonaPlex batched inference."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang_omni.models.personaplex.architecture import DEPFORMER
+from sglang_omni.platforms import current_platform
+
+if current_platform.is_cuda():
+    import triton
+    import triton.language as tl
+    import triton.language.extra.cuda.libdevice as libdevice
+else:
+    triton = None
+    tl = None
+    libdevice = None
+
+NORM_VECTOR_ELEMENTS = 4
+NORM_THREADS = DEPFORMER.dim // NORM_VECTOR_ELEMENTS
+WARP_THREADS = 32
+GATE_BLOCK_ELEMENTS = 256
+GATE_BLOCK_COUNT = (
+    DEPFORMER.ffn_hidden + GATE_BLOCK_ELEMENTS - 1
+) // GATE_BLOCK_ELEMENTS
+SUPPORTED_DTYPES: frozenset[torch.dtype] = frozenset(
+    (torch.float32, torch.bfloat16, torch.float16)
+)
+
+
+if triton is not None:
+
+    @triton.jit
+    def rms_norm_f32_kernel(
+        hidden_states: tl.tensor,
+        alpha: tl.tensor,
+        normalized_states: tl.tensor,
+        epsilon: float,
+        norm_threads: tl.constexpr,
+        reduction_stages: tl.constexpr,
+        dimension: tl.constexpr,
+        vector_elements: tl.constexpr,
+    ) -> None:
+        row_index = tl.program_id(0)
+        lane_indices = tl.arange(0, norm_threads)
+        lane_sums = tl.full((norm_threads,), 0, tl.float32)
+        for vector_index in tl.static_range(vector_elements):
+            vector_sums = tl.full((norm_threads,), 0, tl.float32)
+            for chunk_index in tl.static_range(
+                dimension // (norm_threads * vector_elements)
+            ):
+                column_indices = (
+                    lane_indices + chunk_index * norm_threads
+                ) * vector_elements + vector_index
+                hidden_values = tl.load(
+                    hidden_states + row_index * dimension + column_indices
+                ).to(tl.float32)
+                squared_values = libdevice.mul_rn(hidden_values, hidden_values)
+                vector_sums = libdevice.add_rn(vector_sums, squared_values)
+            lane_sums = libdevice.add_rn(lane_sums, vector_sums)
+        for reduction_stage in tl.static_range(reduction_stages):
+            reduction_offset = norm_threads >> (reduction_stage + 1)
+            shuffled_sums = tl.gather(
+                lane_sums, lane_indices ^ reduction_offset, axis=0
+            )
+            lane_sums = libdevice.add_rn(lane_sums, shuffled_sums)
+        row_sum = tl.gather(lane_sums, tl.full((1,), 0, tl.int32), axis=0)
+        variance = libdevice.add_rn(libdevice.mul_rn(row_sum, 1.0 / dimension), epsilon)
+        inverse_rms = libdevice.rsqrt(variance)
+        column_indices = tl.arange(0, dimension)
+        hidden_values = tl.load(
+            hidden_states + row_index * dimension + column_indices
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        alpha_values = tl.load(alpha + column_indices).to(tl.float32)
+        normalized_values = libdevice.mul_rn(
+            hidden_values, libdevice.mul_rn(alpha_values, inverse_rms)
+        )
+        tl.store(
+            normalized_states + row_index * dimension + column_indices,
+            normalized_values,
+        )
+
+    @triton.jit
+    def silu_gate_kernel(
+        gate_up: tl.tensor,
+        activated_states: tl.tensor,
+        hidden_dimension: tl.constexpr,
+        block_elements: tl.constexpr,
+    ) -> None:
+        row_index = tl.program_id(0)
+        column_indices = tl.program_id(1) * block_elements + tl.arange(
+            0, block_elements
+        )
+        column_mask = column_indices < hidden_dimension
+        gate = tl.load(
+            gate_up + row_index * 2 * hidden_dimension + column_indices,
+            mask=column_mask,
+            other=0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        up = tl.load(
+            gate_up
+            + row_index * 2 * hidden_dimension
+            + hidden_dimension
+            + column_indices,
+            mask=column_mask,
+            other=0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        activated_gate = libdevice.div_rn(
+            gate, libdevice.add_rn(1.0, libdevice.exp(-gate))
+        )
+        rounded_gate = activated_gate.to(gate_up.dtype.element_ty).to(tl.float32)

+def stage_distribution(
+    logits: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    presence_mask: torch.Tensor,
+    stop_suppressed: bool,
+    repetition_penalty: float,
+    temperature: float,
+    top_k: int,
+    top_p: float,
+    recent_tokens: list[int],
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Enumerate the stage's sample-then-redraw procedure for one row exactly."""
+    logits = logits.double().clone()
+    if stop_suppressed:
+        logits[VOCAB_SIZE:] = float("-inf")
+    else:
+        pass
+    logits = torch.where(
+        presence_mask,
+        torch.where(
+            logits < 0, logits * repetition_penalty, logits / repetition_penalty
+        ),
+        logits,
+    )
+    if top_k == 1:
+        return torch.nn.functional.one_hot(logits.argmax(), TOTAL_VOCAB_SIZE).double()
+    else:
+        pass
+    tempered = torch.softmax(logits / temperature, dim=-1)
+    sorted_probabilities, sorted_ids = tempered.sort(descending=True)
+    cumulative = sorted_probabilities.cumsum(dim=-1)
+    distribution = torch.zeros(TOTAL_VOCAB_SIZE, dtype=torch.float64)
+    nucleus_mass = 0.0
+    candidates: list[tuple[int, float]] = []
+    for rank in range(TOTAL_VOCAB_SIZE):
+        probability = float(sorted_probabilities[rank])
+        if rank >= top_k or float(cumulative[rank]) - probability > top_p:
+            break
+        else:
+            candidates.append((int(sorted_ids[rank]), probability))
+            nucleus_mass += probability
+    window = set(recent_tokens)
+    for candidate, probability in candidates:
+        weight = probability / nucleus_mass
+        if candidate < VOCAB_SIZE and candidate in window:
+            redraw = tempered.clone()
+            redraw[candidate] = 0.0
+            if float(redraw.sum()) > 0:
+                distribution += weight * redraw / redraw.sum()
+            else:
+                distribution[candidate] += weight
+        else:
+            distribution[candidate] += weight
+    return distribution
+

+def test_rejection_sampling_reproduces_the_target_distribution() -> None:
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    samples, draft_count, vocab_size = 400_000, 2, 5
+    target_rows = torch.tensor(
+        [
+            [0.1, 0.4, 0.3, 0.2, 0.0],
+            [0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.0],
+            [0.0, 0.0, 0.5, 0.5, 0.0],
+        ]
+    )
+    draft_logits_rows = torch.log(
+        torch.tensor([[0.5, 0.1, 0.1, 0.2, 0.1], [0.1, 0.6, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1]])
+    )
+    draft_probabilities = torch.softmax(draft_logits_rows, dim=-1)
+    draft_tokens = torch.stack(
+        [
+            torch.multinomial(draft_probabilities[step], samples, replacement=True)
+            for step in range(draft_count)
+        ],
+        dim=1,
+    )
+    accepted_count, next_tokens = rejection_sample(
+        target=target_rows.expand(samples, -1, -1),
+        draft_logits=draft_logits_rows.expand(samples, -1, -1),
+        draft_tokens=draft_tokens,
+        temperatures=torch.ones(samples),
+        greedy=torch.zeros(samples, dtype=torch.bool),
+        uniform_noise=torch.rand(samples, draft_count),
+        exponential_noise=torch.empty(samples, vocab_size).exponential_(),
+    )
+    first_tokens = torch.where(accepted_count > 0, draft_tokens[:, 0], next_tokens)
+    first_distribution = torch.bincount(first_tokens, minlength=vocab_size) / samples
+    torch.testing.assert_close(first_distribution, target_rows[0], atol=4e-3, rtol=0)
+    # Acceptance of a sampled proposal is the overlap of the two distributions.
+    expected_acceptance = torch.minimum(target_rows[0], draft_probabilities[0]).sum()
+    assert (
+        abs(float((accepted_count > 0).float().mean()) - float(expected_acceptance))
+        < 4e-3
+    )

+def test_draft_block_draws_each_step_from_the_logits_it_returns() -> None:
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    rank, steps = 4, 3
+    base_logits = torch.randn(2, steps, TOTAL_VOCAB_SIZE)
+    # The first stop id would win every step without the minimum-length mask.
+    base_logits[:, :, VOCAB_SIZE] = 50.0
+    markov_embedding = torch.randn(TOTAL_VOCAB_SIZE, rank)
+    markov_projection = torch.randn(TOTAL_VOCAB_SIZE, rank)
+    presence_mask = torch.zeros(2, TOTAL_VOCAB_SIZE, dtype=torch.bool)
+    presence_mask[:, 7] = True
+    draft_tokens, shaped_logits = sample_draft_block(
+        base_logits,
+        torch.tensor([7, 9]),
+        torch.empty(2, steps, TOTAL_VOCAB_SIZE).exponential_(),
+        markov_embedding,
+        markov_projection,
+        presence_mask,
+        torch.tensor([1.3, 1.0]),
+        torch.tensor([4, 4]),
+        torch.tensor([6, 0]),
+        torch.tensor([0.8, 1.0]),
+        torch.tensor([False, True]),
+    )
+
+    previous = torch.tensor([7, 9])
+    history = presence_mask.clone()
+    for step in range(steps):
+        expected = (
+            base_logits[:, step] + markov_embedding[previous] @ markov_projection.T
+        )
+        expected[0, VOCAB_SIZE:] = (
+            float("-inf") if 4 + step < 6 else expected[0, VOCAB_SIZE:]
+        )
+        penalized = torch.where(expected < 0, expected * 1.3, expected / 1.3)
+        expected[0] = torch.where(history[0], penalized[0], expected[0])
+        torch.testing.assert_close(shaped_logits[:, step], expected)
+        assert int(draft_tokens[1, step]) == int(expected[1].argmax())
+        history.scatter_(1, draft_tokens[:, step : step + 1], True)
+        previous = draft_tokens[:, step]
+    # The masked stop id never wins while the minimum length is unmet.
+    assert (draft_tokens[0, :2] != VOCAB_SIZE).all()
+

+def test_exact_accept_verifies_each_row_with_the_drafts_before_it() -> None:
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    batch, drafts = 2, 3
+    rows = drafts + 1
+    target_logits = torch.randn(batch * rows, TOTAL_VOCAB_SIZE)
+    draft_tokens = torch.tensor([[11, 12, 13], [21, 22, 23]])
+    for row in range(batch):
+        for draft in range(drafts):
+            target_logits[row * rows + draft, draft_tokens[row, draft]] = 20.0
+    presence_mask = torch.zeros(batch, TOTAL_VOCAB_SIZE, dtype=torch.bool)
+    presence_mask[:, 5] = True
+    recent_tokens = torch.full((batch, COSYVOICE3_RAS_WINDOW_SIZE), EMPTY_HISTORY_TOKEN)
+    recent_tokens[:, -1] = 5
+    arguments = dict(
+        presence_mask=presence_mask,
+        repetition_penalties=torch.tensor([1.2, 1.0]),
+        output_lengths=torch.tensor([3, 3]),
+        min_new_tokens=torch.tensor([5, 0]),
+        temperatures=torch.tensor([0.7, 0.9]),
+        greedy=torch.tensor([False, False]),
+        top_ks=torch.tensor([20, 15]),
+        top_ps=torch.tensor([0.8, 0.95]),
+        recent_tokens=recent_tokens,
+    )
+    # Accept every draft and draw the bonus from the last row, so that row's
+    # distribution decides the next token.
+    accepted_count, next_tokens = exact_accept(
+        target_logits,
+        torch.zeros(batch, drafts, TOTAL_VOCAB_SIZE),
+        draft_tokens,
+        **arguments,
+        uniform_noise=torch.zeros(batch, drafts),
+        exponential_noise=torch.ones(batch, TOTAL_VOCAB_SIZE),
+    )
+
+    assert accepted_count.tolist() == [drafts, drafts]
+    for row in range(batch):
+        history = presence_mask[row].clone()
+        history[draft_tokens[row]] = True
+        window = recent_tokens[row].tolist()[drafts:] + draft_tokens[row].tolist()
+        expected = target_probabilities(
+            target_logits[row * rows + drafts : row * rows + rows],
+            presence_mask=history.unsqueeze(0),
+            stop_suppressed=torch.tensor(
+                [3 + drafts < int(arguments["min_new_tokens"][row])]
+            ),
+            repetition_penalties=arguments["repetition_penalties"][row : row + 1],
+            temperatures=arguments["temperatures"][row : row + 1],
+            top_ks=arguments["top_ks"][row : row + 1],
+            top_ps=arguments["top_ps"][row : row + 1],
+            recent_tokens=torch.tensor([window]),
+        )
+        assert int(next_tokens[row]) == int(expected.argmax())
+

+def test_request_histories_track_each_slot_through_reuse() -> None:
+    histories = RequestHistories(slot_count=4, device=torch.device("cpu"))
+
+    def presence(*requests: SimpleNamespace) -> list[list[int]]:
+        batch = SimpleNamespace(
+            reqs=list(requests),
+            req_pool_indices=torch.tensor(
+                [request.kv.req_pool_idx for request in requests]
+            ),
+        )
+        return [
+            row.nonzero().flatten().tolist() for row in histories.presence_mask(batch)
+        ]
+
+    first = SimpleNamespace(
+        rid="a", kv=SimpleNamespace(req_pool_idx=2), output_ids=array("q", [7, 9])
+    )
+    second = SimpleNamespace(
+        rid="b", kv=SimpleNamespace(req_pool_idx=1), output_ids=array("q", [3])
+    )
+    assert presence(first, second) == [[7, 9], [3]]
+    first.output_ids.extend([9, 11])
+    assert presence(first) == [[7, 9, 11]]
+    # A new request on a freed slot starts from an empty history.
+    reused = SimpleNamespace(
+        rid="c", kv=SimpleNamespace(req_pool_idx=2), output_ids=array("q", [5])
+    )
+    assert presence(reused, second) == [[5], [3]]
+    # So does a new request that reuses a finished request's id and slot.
+    same_id = SimpleNamespace(
+        rid="b", kv=SimpleNamespace(req_pool_idx=1), output_ids=array("q", [4])
+    )
+    assert presence(same_id) == [[4]]

+def dialog_stage(identity):
+    """The text dialog under its session scheduler, a builder of the stage's operations, and a runner of one on its own thread."""
+    settings = ComponentGraphConfig.model_validate(yaml.safe_load(TEXT_ONLY_STOPPABLE))
+    scheduler = SessionScheduler(
+        ComponentHooks("dialog", settings, timeout_s=5), max_concurrency=2
+    )
+
+    def operation(request_id, kind, chunk=None, *, should_preempt=False):
+        metadata = operation_metadata(
+            kind, identity, chunk, should_preempt=should_preempt
+        )
+        return StagePayload(request_id, OmniRequest(None, metadata=metadata), {})
+
+    def start(payload):
+        scheduler.inbox.put(IncomingMessage(payload.request_id, "new_request", payload))
+        message = scheduler.inbox.get_nowait()
+        thread = threading.Thread(target=scheduler.compute, args=(message.data,))
+        thread.start()
+        return thread
+
+    return scheduler, operation, start
+
+
+def streamed(scheduler):
+    """The request id and chunk of each stream message the stage sent so far."""
+    messages = []
+    while not scheduler.outbox.empty():
+        message = scheduler.outbox.get_nowait()
+        if message.type == "stream":
+            messages.append((message.request_id, TimedChunk.from_dict(message.data)))
+        else:
+            pass
+    return messages
+

+"""Perception and language-model checkpoint names, without loading tensors."""

+from __future__ import annotations

+PACKAGE = (
+    Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+    / "sglang_omni"
+    / "models"
+    / "nemotron_transcribe"
+)
+
+
+def test_package_does_not_import_nemo() -> None:
+    offenders: list[str] = []
+    for path in sorted(PACKAGE.glob("*.py")):
+        tree = ast.parse(path.read_text())
+        for node in ast.walk(tree):
+            if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
+                names = [alias.name for alias in node.names]
+            elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
+                names = [node.module or ""]
+            else:
+                continue
+            for name in names:
+                if name == "nemo" or name.startswith("nemo."):
+                    offenders.append(f"{path.name}:{name}")
+                else:
+                    pass
+    assert offenders == []
+
+
+def test_language_model_names_cover_the_decoder_remap() -> None:
+    samples = {
+        "llm.model.embed_tokens.weight": ("rename", "backbone.embed_tokens.weight"),
+        "llm.lm_head.weight": ("rename", "lm_head.weight"),
+        "llm.model.norm.weight": ("rename", "backbone.norm_f.weight"),
+        "llm.model.layers.0.mixer._fp32_params.A_log": (
+            "rename",
+            "backbone.layers.0.mixer.A_log",
+        ),
+        "llm.model.layers.3.mixer.experts.down_projs": (
+            "split_down",
+            "backbone.layers.3.mixer",
+        ),
+        "llm.model.layers.3.mixer.experts.gate_and_up_projs": (
+            "split_up",
+            "backbone.layers.3.mixer",
+        ),
+        "llm.mtp.layers.0.mixer.q_proj.weight": ("skip", ""),
+        "ctc_timestamp.decoder.decoder_layers.0.weight": ("skip", ""),
+        "llm.lm_head._extra_state": ("skip", ""),
+        "perception.proj.weight": ("perception", "proj.weight"),
+    }
+    for name, expected in samples.items():
+        assert classify_checkpoint_name(name) == expected
+
+
+def test_expert_weight_conversion_preserves_ungated_relu2_computation() -> None:
+    up_weights = torch.arange(24, dtype=torch.float32).reshape(2, 3, 4) / 16
+    down_weights = torch.arange(24, dtype=torch.float32).reshape(2, 4, 3) / 16
+    converted = dict(
+        checkpoint_to_language_model_weights(
+            [
+                ("llm.model.layers.3.mixer.experts.gate_and_up_projs", up_weights),
+                ("llm.model.layers.3.mixer.experts.down_projs", down_weights),
+            ]
+        )
+    )
+    hidden_states = torch.tensor([[1.0, -2.0, 3.0]])
+    for expert_index in range(2):
+        prefix = f"backbone.layers.3.mixer.experts.{expert_index}"
+        reference = (
+            F.relu(hidden_states @ up_weights[expert_index]).square()
+            @ down_weights[expert_index]

+        actual = F.linear(

+                F.linear(hidden_states, converted[f"{prefix}.up_proj.weight"])
+            ).square(),
+            converted[f"{prefix}.down_proj.weight"],
+        )
+        torch.testing.assert_close(actual, reference)

+"""Encoder replay correctness across requests, shapes and compilation."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang_omni.models.nemotron_transcribe.encoder_cuda_graph import EncoderCudaGraphs
+from sglang_omni.models.nemotron_transcribe.speech_transformer import (
+    SpeechTransformerEncoder,
+)
+
+pytestmark = [
+    pytest.mark.accelerator,
+    pytest.mark.skipif(not torch.cuda.is_available(), reason="requires CUDA"),
+]
+
+
+def masked_projection(
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor, valid_key_mask: torch.Tensor | None
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    output = hidden_states.sin() * 2.0
+    if valid_key_mask is not None:
+        output = output * valid_key_mask.unsqueeze(-1)
+    else:
+        pass
+    return output
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def test_replay_and_shape_limit_preserve_independent_outputs() -> None:
+    replay = EncoderCudaGraphs(masked_projection)
+    retained_outputs = []
+    for frame_count in [4, 7, 4, 11, 13, 7, 17, 4]:
+        hidden_states = torch.randn(2, frame_count, 8, device="cuda")
+        valid_mask = torch.rand(2, frame_count, device="cuda") > 0.3
+        output = replay(hidden_states, valid_mask)
+        reference = masked_projection(hidden_states, valid_mask)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(output, reference)
+        retained_outputs.append((output, reference))
+    for output, reference in retained_outputs:
+        torch.testing.assert_close(output, reference)
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def test_compiled_encoder_replays_changed_content_and_batches() -> None:
+    torch.manual_seed(3)
+    encoder = (
+        SpeechTransformerEncoder(
+            feat_in=4,
+            d_model=16,
+            n_heads=2,
+            n_layers=1,
+            subsampling_factor=2,
+            drop_rate=0.0,
+        )
+        .cuda()
+        .eval()
+    )
+    samples = [
+        (
+            torch.randn(batch_size, 4, 12, device="cuda"),
+            torch.full((batch_size,), 12, device="cuda"),
+        )
+        for batch_size in [1, 3, 2, 3]
+    ]
+    references = [encoder(signal, lengths)[0].clone() for signal, lengths in samples]
+    encoder.compile_layers(mode="default", cuda_graphs=True, dynamic=True)
+    for (signal, lengths), reference in zip(samples + samples, references + references):

+        torch.testing.assert_close(output, reference, rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-4)

+"""Pre-LM perception encode stays off the decoder step."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import threading
+from collections.abc import Iterator
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import Modality, MultimodalDataItem
+
+from sglang_omni.models.nemotron_transcribe.encoder_service import (
+    NemotronTranscribePreLMEncoderService,

+)
+
+HIDDEN_SIZE = 4
+SERVICES: list[NemotronTranscribePreLMEncoderService] = []
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def close_services() -> Iterator[None]:
+    yield
+    for service in SERVICES:
+        service.close()
+    SERVICES.clear()
+
+
+class Perception(torch.nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.proj = torch.nn.Linear(2, HIDDEN_SIZE, bias=False)
+
+
+class StubModel(torch.nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.perception = Perception()
+        self.config = None
+        self.encode_calls = 0
+        self.encode_batch_sizes: list[int] = []
+        self.encode_gate: threading.Event | None = None
+        self.encode_started: threading.Event | None = None
+        self.fail_next = False
+        self.fail_multi_item = False
+
+    def get_audio_feature(self, items: list[MultimodalDataItem]) -> torch.Tensor:
+        self.encode_calls += 1
+        self.encode_batch_sizes.append(len(items))
+        if self.encode_started is not None:
+            self.encode_started.set()
+        gate = self.encode_gate
+        if gate is not None:
+            self.encode_gate = None
+            assert gate.wait(timeout=5)
+        else:
+            pass
+        if self.fail_next:
+            self.fail_next = False
+            raise RuntimeError("encode failed")
+        else:
+            pass
+        if self.fail_multi_item and len(items) > 1:
+            self.fail_multi_item = False
+            raise RuntimeError("batched encode failed")
+        else:
+            pass
+        dtype = self.perception.proj.weight.dtype
+        return torch.cat(
+            [
+                torch.full((int(item.num_audio_tokens), HIDDEN_SIZE), 1.0, dtype=dtype)
+                for item in items
+            ],
+            dim=0,
+        )
+
+
+def make_service(
+    model: StubModel | None = None, *, max_batch_size: int = 4
+) -> NemotronTranscribePreLMEncoderService:
+    service = NemotronTranscribePreLMEncoderService(
+        model or StubModel(),
+        cache_namespace="nemotron-test",
+        cache_max_entries=8,
+        cache_max_bytes=1 << 20,
+        max_batch_size=max_batch_size,
+        max_batch_wait_ms=0,
+    )
+    SERVICES.append(service)
+    return service
+
+
+def make_item(fingerprint: str, tokens: int, samples: int) -> MultimodalDataItem:
+    return MultimodalDataItem(
+        modality=Modality.AUDIO,
+        feature=torch.zeros(samples),
+        model_specific_data={
+            "audio_fingerprint": fingerprint,
+            "num_audio_tokens": tokens,
+        },
+    )
+
+
+def test_clips_longer_than_one_minute_do_not_share_a_batch() -> None:
+    short = 1600
+    assert clips_share_a_batch(short, short * 2)
+    assert not clips_share_a_batch(short, short * 5)
+    assert not clips_share_a_batch(61 * 16000, short)

+    model = StubModel()
+    service = make_service(model)
+    item = make_item("clip", 3, 1600)
+
+    service.encode_item(item)
+
+    assert item.precomputed_embeddings.shape == (3, HIDDEN_SIZE)
+    assert item.precomputed_embeddings.dtype == model.perception.proj.weight.dtype
+    assert item.feature is None
+    assert item.format.name == "PRECOMPUTED_EMBEDDING"
+    assert model.encode_calls == 1

+    second = make_item("clip", 3, 1600)

+    service.encode_item(second)

+
+def test_short_clips_encode_together() -> None:

+    gate = threading.Event()
+    started = threading.Event()
+    model.encode_gate = gate

+    service = make_service(model)

+def test_long_upload_does_not_pad_a_short_clip() -> None:

+        service.submit_item(make_item("long", 4, 61 * 16000)),
+        service.submit_item(make_item("b", 2, 1600)),
+    ]
+    gate.set()
+    first.result(timeout=2)
+    for future in pending:
+        future.result(timeout=2)

+    assert model.encode_batch_sizes == [1, 1, 1]

+    gate = threading.Event()

+    asr = SpeechTransformerEncoder(

+        d_model=16,

+        n_layers=1,

+def complex_rotary_reference(
+    tokens: torch.Tensor, positions: torch.Tensor
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    frequencies = 10000.0 ** (-torch.arange(0, 4, 2).float() / 4)
+    phases = positions[:, None] * frequencies
+    rotated = torch.complex(tokens[..., :2], tokens[..., 2:4]) * torch.polar(
+        torch.ones_like(phases), phases
+    )
+    return torch.cat([rotated.real, rotated.imag, tokens[..., 4:]], dim=-1)
+
+

+    actual_queries, actual_keys = rotary.apply_rotary(queries, keys)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        actual_queries, complex_rotary_reference(queries, torch.arange(5))
+    )
+    torch.testing.assert_close(

+    )

+class RecordingEncoder:
+    def __init__(self, embedding: torch.Tensor | None = None) -> None:
+        self.embedding = embedding
+        self.lookup: tuple[str, int] | None = None
+        self.encoded: object | None = None
+        self.waited = False
+
+    def lookup_cached_embedding(
+        self, audio_fingerprint: str, expected_tokens: int
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        self.lookup = (audio_fingerprint, expected_tokens)
+        return self.embedding
+
+    def attach_embedding(self, item: object, embedding: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+        item.precomputed_embeddings = embedding
+        item.feature = None
+
+    def encode_item(self, item: object) -> None:
+        self.waited = True
+        self.encoded = item.feature
+        item.precomputed_embeddings = torch.zeros((item.num_audio_tokens, 4))
+        item.feature = None
+
+    def submit_item(self, item: object) -> concurrent.futures.Future[torch.Tensor]:
+        self.encoded = item.feature
+        item.precomputed_embeddings = torch.zeros((item.num_audio_tokens, 4))
+        item.feature = None
+        future: concurrent.futures.Future[torch.Tensor] = concurrent.futures.Future()
+        future.set_result(item.precomputed_embeddings)
+        return future
+
